jobs.description:
1\.0 FTE Full time Day \- 08 Hour R2659597 Onsite 108420003 Security LPCH Business \& Administration NEWARK, 7999 Gateway Blvd, California
If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

  


Day \- 08 Hour (United States of America)
Be the force behind the projects and people that keep a major healthcare division moving forward. This is an opportunity to step into a highly dynamic role where your ability to connect teams, drive initiatives, and create meaningful employee experiences will directly influence engagement across Facilities Infrastructure \& Safety.

  

In this highly visible role, you will partner with senior leaders and executive stakeholders to coordinate division\-wide initiatives, support special projects, and help drive engagement efforts across Facilities Infrastructure \& Safety. Success comes from balancing strategic planning with seamless execution while managing communications, events, and cross\-functional collaboration in a fast\-paced environment. Key strengths include:

* Project coordination and organizational planning
* Executive presence and professionalism when supporting senior leadership
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including employee engagement and marketing\-style communications
* Experience coordinating large\-scale events, conferences, vendors, and stakeholder activities
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and build relationships across teams and departments
* Provide high\-level administrative support, including complex calendaring, meeting facilitation and coordination requiring strong program and operational execution
  

The **Facilities Services** division enhances health through leadership, collaboration, and innovation. Our team offers essential non\-clinical support 24/7, ensuring safe operations and planning for future needs. We represent the intersection of planning, construction, general services, and facilities operations. Learn more about Facilities Services at: Facilities Services \| Stanford Health Care

  

The **Facilities Infrastructure \& Safety** (FIS) business unit is vital in ensuring the safety, security, and operational integrity of Stanford Health Care facilities while also managing disaster preparedness and complex building systems to foster a secure healthcare environment. FIS is made up of multiple departments aligned in focus: **Environmental Health \& Safety, Facility Field Services, Protective Services, Security Services, Office of Emergency Management, Facilities Engineering \- Systems, Operational Technology, Facilities Engineering\- Infrastructure, Facilities Services Response Center,** and **Facilities Administration and Operations.**

 **Facilities Administration and Operations** (FAO) drives strategic alignment and continuous improvement across operational functions by leveraging data\-driven processes and best practices to enhance service quality and create a safe, efficient environment.

  

If you are interested in joining Stanford Health Care, please read the job description below and apply online.

 **This is a Stanford Health Care job.**  

  

**A Brief Overview**  

Sr Program Project Coordinators manage daily project activities in conjunction with project and senior project managers who provide centralized oversight/structure to multiple VP areas in executing complex, organization\-wide projects (such as the 500P activation). Projects require the complex coordination of space planning, facilities construction, logistics, compliance and clinic operational planning. In addition, Senior Project Coordinators independently manage related projects of smaller scope. Senior Project Coordinators assume responsibility for key project team members, deliverables and activities, resource/equipment/information coordination. Senior Project Coordinators use their independent judgement to resolve or triage critical issues, identify risks and escalations, provide project schedule updates and exercise financial responsibility.  

  

**Locations**  

Stanford Health Care

jobs.title: Senior Staff Operations Manager, Office of the President (PED)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Chief of Staff–style operator to serve as the President's right hand and help run, maintain, and continuously evolve the Product, Engineering \& Design operating model and cadence.



This role will turn strategy into a durable execution system. You will own the connective tissue across the President's leadership cadence: preparing the right inputs, creating clarity on decisions and tradeoffs, ensuring commitments are followed through, surfacing risks early, and improving the operating model as the organization changes. You will work across Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Finance, People, and your peers in Business Operations, partnering with senior leaders who do not report to you and influencing through judgment, trust, and clarity.



The successful candidate will combine executive judgment, operational rigor, business acumen, comfort with ambiguity, strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to move fluidly between strategic questions and the execution details required to make the system work.



AI fluency is an important part of this role. You will use approved enterprise AI tools, including tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Glean, Cursor, or comparable platforms, to automate repeatable operating work, synthesize information across functions, improve leadership preparation, surface risks and dependencies, and accelerate strategic\-initiative delivery.



This role reports to the VP of Operations at Squarespace and is based remotely in California or locally at our New York City headquarters.


**You'll Get To…**
------------------


* **Run the President's operating cadence**. Own end\-to\-end orchestration of the leadership rhythm: staff meetings, WBRs, MBRs, and QBRs, finance and portfolio reviews, priority updates, and annual operating\-plan inputs. Ensure each ritual has a clear purpose, owner, input, output, decision authority, and downstream cascade.
* **Drive decision quality.** Synthesize diverse inputs into concise narratives that make priorities, risks, options, tradeoffs, and recommended decisions clear to the President and leadership team. Document decisions in the room, assign owners and deadlines, track commitments, and escalate unresolved issues with context and a proposed path forward.
* **Improve execution velocity.** Identify alignment and execution risks before they surface as leadership surprises, and facilitate resolution across Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Customer Operations, Finance, People, and Business Operations, connecting planning, performance, financial, organizational, and roadmap inputs. Use AI and advanced tooling to make decisions faster and better\-informed.
* **Evolve the operating model.** Treat the operating system as a living thing. Establish health measures such as decision latency, action closure, cascade reach, pre\-read quality, participation, recurring issue themes, and use them to assess whether rituals, artifacts, and escalation paths are producing the right outcomes. Recommend and implement changes to cadence, governance, templates, roles, and channels as strategy and priorities evolve, codifying what works so the model is easy for leaders to understand and operate.
* **Lead high\-priority strategic initiatives.** Drive complex, ambiguous, cross\-functional work on behalf of the President, from framing and workplan through decision, implementation, and follow\-through, including emerging problems that don't yet have a clear owner. Support annual strategy, goals, headcount, and budget processes by connecting them to the department's operating rhythm.
* **Represent the President and build transparency.** Stand in for the President in meetings, events, and discussions, exercising the remit of the position. Navigate difficult conversations and cross\-functional tradeoffs without relying on formal authority. Support two\-way access to the President through Town Halls, Roundtables, Office Hours, and written follow\-up, using sound judgment about what should be broadly communicated, selectively shared, or handled privately.
* **Serve as a trusted thought partner** to the President and senior leadership team, offering an independent perspective and respectfully challenging assumptions when needed.

**Who We're Looking For**
-------------------------


* Significant experience in Chief of Staff, Product Operations, Business Operations, Strategy \& Operations, or management consulting
* A track record of owning an operating model, leadership cadence, or portfolio of complex cross\-functional initiatives, preferably in tech companies
* Knowledge of the product / software development lifecycle
* Demonstrated proficiency with enterprise AI tools, such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Glean, Cursor, or comparable approved tools, and experience integrating them into daily workflows to automate repeatable tasks, optimize processes, improve synthesis, and accelerate project delivery.
* Exceptional written communication: you can turn a large volume of input into a concise, decision\-ready narrative tailored to the audience
* Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to understand metrics, forecasts, resource tradeoffs, product or portfolio performance, and organizational implications.
* Strong executive presence and facilitation skills; you can create clarity and momentum in high\-stakes or ambiguous settings.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, build consensus, resolve conflict, and push for decisions without formal authority.
* High judgment and discretion when handling sensitive organizational, people, financial, and strategic information.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity, switching between strategic altitude and detailed execution, and taking ownership of problems that cross organizational boundaries.
* A continuous\-improvement mindset: you distinguish between process and content, challenge ineffective routines, and make change practical and durable.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Alternative Data - Data Evaluations and Onboarding
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**
The Bloomberg Alternative Data team is a fast\-growing, high\-impact product group building the next generation of data and analytics for company research and intelligence. Our mission is to make alternative data as essential to investment workflows as traditional fundamentals \- at global scale.  

  

As product managers, we sit at the intersection of data science, engineering, sales, and clients, and are responsible for some of Bloomberg's most differentiated data capabilities. A core part of that mission is ensuring we can identify, evaluate, and productize the best external data \- quickly and at scale.  

  

**What's in It for You:**
Bloomberg's Alternative Data team is seeking a Product Manager to own our dataset evaluation and onboarding function \- the critical process by which we determine whether a dataset meets our product strategy and turn contracted data into production\-ready product capabilities.  

  

This is a highly cross\-functional, strategic, and analytically rigorous role. You will build and manage the systems that allow Bloomberg to evaluate datasets efficiently, make sound investment decisions, and onboard new data sources at scale. You will work across the full data partnership lifecycle \- from translating product requirements into evaluation frameworks, to managing the team’s evaluation pipeline, to getting newly contracted datasets production\-ready.  

  

You will have a direct impact on the quality and pace of Bloomberg's alternative data product portfolio, with visibility across product leadership, engineering, data science, and our data vendor ecosystem.  

  

**We'll Trust You to:**
**Own the Dataset Evaluation Process**
* Manage the evaluation pipeline end\-to\-end: prioritization, timelines, and throughput across a concurrent set of active evaluations.
* Translate product strategy requirements into structured, rigorous evaluation frameworks: defining the criteria, methodology, and outputs by which datasets are assessed against the product bar.
* Collaborate with the engineering evaluations team: setting requirements for their analytical work and ensuring results are transparent and decision\-ready for product leadership.
* Engage directly with data providers during evaluations: efficiently resolving questions and gather the information needed to complete assessments.
* Continuously improve evaluation processes over time: standardizing, streamlining, and productizing evaluation workflows to increase speed, rigor, and scalability.
  
  

**Drive Data Onboarding \& Productization**
* Own the end\-to\-end onboarding plan for newly contracted datasets \- from establishing delivery and technical requirements with the data provider to managing dependencies, launch criteria, and timelines.
* Translate product and business requirements into precise, implementation\-ready data and operational specifications \- bridging the gap between what the product needs and what engineering and providers must deliver.
* Define and manage ongoing data quality monitoring for onboarded datasets, ensuring production reliability post\-launch.
* Drive Cross\-Functional Execution collaborating with data scientists, engineers, data scouts, other product managers and data vendors across the partnership lifecycle.
  
  

**Define and Own Success Metrics**
* Establish metrics for evaluation throughput, onboarding speed, and data quality \- and track them rigorously.
* Continuously assess and improve the efficiency and scalability of both the evaluation and onboarding processes.
  
  

**You'll Need to Have:**
* 5\+ years of product experience, with meaningful time spent on alternative data products.
* Strong understanding of alternative data and how institutional investors use it.
* Demonstrated experience building or managing structured analytical or operational processes, ideally in a data evaluation, data quality, or data onboarding context.
* Hands\-on experience working with data \- including data quality frameworks, QA practices, and the operational realities of delivering reliable data at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to translate high\-level product requirements into detailed operational and technical specifications.
* Experience working directly with data engineers, data scientists, and cross\-functional stakeholders in large organizations.
* Experience working directly with third\-party data vendors or managing external data provider relationships.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to produce clear, decision\-ready outputs for product leadership and external partners alike.
* Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage a concurrent pipeline of evaluations and onboarding workstreams without losing sight of timelines or quality.
  
  

**We’d love to see:**
* Product management experience building data, analytics, or research platforms.
* Experience operating in large organizations with multiple stakeholders.
Salary Range \= 140,000 \- 295,000 USD Annual \+ Benefits \+ Bonus  

  

The referenced salary range is based on the Company's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level.  

  

  

  

We offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans available and offer a range of total rewards that may include merit increases, incentive compensation (exempt roles only), paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) \+match, life insurance, and various wellness programs, among others. The Sr. Marketing Operations Manager role serves as a critical bridge between AWS Marketing Strategy, Operations, and Enablement (MSOE) to Senior Leaders throughout AWS Marketing. In this role, you will work closely across AWS Marketing to continuously improve processes, drive execution excellence, and deliver marketing results. You will be aligned to an AWS Marketing Team and have direct responsibility for annual planning, budget management, headcount management, rhythms of the business, ad hoc reporting, and enablement. This will be done through your ability to orchestrate the right people and teams to deliver against a defined request, project, or program. jobs.title: Clinical Operations Manager
jobs.description:
*Clinic Operations Manager – San Jose –* (.375 FTE)

RotaCare Bay Area (RBA) is a volunteer alliance of medical professionals, organizations and community members dedicated to providing free primary, quality healthcare services to uninsured families and individuals with limited ability to pay for medical care. We are a volunteer driven organization supported primarily through locally based philanthropy. RBA’s network of 10 free medical clinics is in six counties throughout the San Francisco Bay Area and Central Coast. RotaCare Bay Area seeks new team members to join its RotaCare Clinics.

**Basic Function:** The Clinic Operations Manager provides administrative leadership and management control of all clinic operations. Clinic coordination, volunteer coordination, continuous quality improvement, and cultivating partnerships are essential aspects of this position. The Clinic Operations Manager will work closely with RBA and the Clinic Advisory Council to advance RBA’s mission as well as participate in program/strategic planning, evaluation, and fund development activities. The clinic operates on Saturdays.

**Reporting Relationships:** The Clinical Operations Manager reports directly to the RotaCare Bay Area CEO. The position also works closely with the volunteer Medical Director and Clinic Advisory Council.

**Knowledge/Responsibilities:**

*Clinic Coordination (35%)*

* Ensure clinical activities comply with RotaCare Bay Area policies and procedures.
* Manage clinic opening, closing, security measures, and housekeeping.
* Manage and communicate clinic schedule to ensure adequate volunteer staffing on clinic days. Resolve volunteer staffing cancellations in collaboration with the partner.
* Monitor and maintain exam room, medical supplies inventory and medical equipment.
* Ensure facilities are orderly, sanitary, and maintained.
* Train and ensure proper usage of electronic health records and documentation in Athena.
* Oversee laboratory and x\-ray procedures, including referrals, follow\-up, reporting, and MD review.
* Work with other social/health agencies and health care professionals to ensure patient needs are addressed. Includes coordinating specialty care and pro\-bono referrals.

*Volunteer Coordination (10%)*

* Ensure volunteer recruitment, training, and coordination with RotaCare Bay Area policies and procedures.
* Monitor volunteers’ performance. Recognize service, provide continuing education, or dismiss.
* Ensure volunteer database is current and accurate. Maintain and organize volunteer records, including assuring all licensing and tests are up to date in volunteer database.

*Continuous Quality Improvement Activities (20%)*

* Implement quality improvement activities in compliance with RotaCare Bay Area policies and procedures.
* Generate and communicate patient data reports.
* Identify and address challenges/barriers to conducting clinical activities.
* Analyze clinical activities to take effective action related to patient care
* Develop and institute solutions that improve clinic management services and healthcare delivery.
* Schedule, coordinate, and prepare for Quality Assurance Site Visits. Review Quality Assurance reports and follow\-up on recommendations. Develop and implement adjustment as necessary.

*Advisory Council Relation and Partnership Development (25%)*

* Work closely with partner on volunteer scheduling and clinic operations.
* Assist Advisory Council Chair with preparation of Advisory Council meeting agendas. Participate in Advisory Council meetings.
* Represent RotaCare at community meetings and events.
* Maintain and build network of social services and referral care providers to supplement patient care provided at clinics.

*General Administrative Activities (10%)*

* Manage office procedures and perform clerical activities.
* Serve as liaison to RotaCare Bay Area and participate in regional RotaCare Bay Area activities (e.g., conferences, teleconferences, meetings).
* Communicate with and respond to inquiries from RotaCare Bay Area and clinic network.
* Performs other duties as required.

**Qualifications and Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university with a minimum 5 years of experience working in a non\-profit health or human service setting with supervisory experience.
* Managing community\-based clinics is desirable.
* Knowledge of health care delivery, administration, quality assurance/CQI, data management, personnel management, and budgetary management.
* Understand medical terminology and ethical/legal issues in relation to healthcare.
* Strong, sensitive, and thorough verbal, written, and interpersonal skills, including leadership and facilitation. Demonstrated experience working with medical personnel and groups from diverse backgrounds. Bilingual Spanish/English preferred.
* Ability to function independently and as a team member. Values team\-oriented, cooperative culture. Ability to coordinate others to provide maximum efficiency.

* Carries out all responsibilities in an honest, ethical and professional manner as well as demonstrates ability to exercise independent discretion and good judgment within parameters of the role and RotaCare Bay Area policies.

jobs.title: Compliance Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Why Socure?**
---------------


Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.


We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

**Compliance Operations Manager**
=================================

**ABOUT THE ROLE**


The line between compliance and technology is disappearing. Financial institutions no longer treat AML programs as a checkbox exercise — they are demanding platforms that embed regulatory intelligence directly into their screening, monitoring, and investigation workflows. Socure is building that platform, and we are looking for a Compliance Operations Manager to be the compliance mind behind it.


This role sits at the center of a four\-way intersection: the evolving regulatory landscape, our product and technology teams, our go\-to\-market motion, and our customers' compliance programs. You will be the compliance partner to engineering and data science, developing the rigorous frameworks, taxonomies, and methodologies that power the context layer underlying our AML platform and features. As regulations evolve — across OFAC, FATF, FinCEN, and international equivalents — you will translate that landscape into product strategy and help shape what Socure builds next.


Beyond internal product work, you will help build Socure's professional services and advisory capability: a program designed to help our customers develop and mature their own AML programs using Socure's platform. You will shape the structure of that program, the partnerships that extend its reach, and the operational model that makes it scalable — positioning Socure as a true compliance partner, not just a technology vendor.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

*Compliance Frameworks \& Context Layer*

* Maintain rigorous frameworks, taxonomies, and methodologies that power the compliance context layer underlying Socure's AML platform — including country risk ratings, sanctions type classification, PEP categorization, and adverse media signal standards – as regulatory guidance, customer requirements, and global coverage expand.
* Partner with Data Science and Engineering to ensure compliance intelligence is accurately represented in Watchlist's data ingestion, entity resolution, and matching systems.
* Maintain and evolve these frameworks leveraging the latest technologies to scale this context layer

*Regulatory Intelligence \& Product Strategy*

* Track developments across OFAC, FATF, FinCEN, and international frameworks and translating them into product and roadmap implications.
* Partner with Product and GTM to shape how regulatory changes become product features, positioning, and customer communications.
* Engage with regulators, industry bodies, and compliance associations to keep Socure at the forefront of the evolving compliance ecosystem.

*Professional Services \& Customer Advisory*

* Help design and build Socure's professional services and advisory capability — a program that helps customers develop and mature their AML programs using Socure's platform.
* Define the structure, partnerships, and operational model that make the advisory program scalable across Socure's growing customer base.
* Work with Sales and Customer Success to deploy compliance advisory as a differentiator in enterprise deals and customer retention.

*Cross\-Functional Collaboration*

* Act as the compliance subject matter expert across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, and Customer Success.
* Support enterprise deals with compliance due diligence, RFP responses, and regulatory inquiry support.
* Interface directly with customers on complex compliance questions, audit support, and program design guidance.
* Drive the product roadmap requirements for features that reduce operational complexity for our customers.
* Develop smart automations using AI and agents that reduce operational burden for our cross\-functional partners.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* 5–7 years of experience in AML compliance operations, sanctions screening, or financial crime operations at a financial institution, fintech, or compliance technology company.
* Working knowledge of OFAC sanctions programs, FATF guidance, BSA/AML regulations, and PEP screening standards.
* Experience maintaining or auditing watchlist and sanctions data sources, including list provenance tracking and quality control.
* Familiarity with GRC frameworks and AML taxonomy structures: sanctions type classification, PEP categories, adverse media signals, and country risk ratings.
* Hands\-on technical operator that is able to leverage technology to improve customer experience and scale operations.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage operational processes with rigorous documentation.
* Effective communicator across technical (Engineering, Data Science) and non\-technical (Sales, Compliance Buyers) stakeholders.
* CAMS certification or equivalent AML compliance credential preferred.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.


We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.


We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.


If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**


As Marketing Operations Manager, you will run the day\-to\-day execution that keeps Crusoe's marketing programs moving. Working closely with our marketing operations lead, you will build and QA campaigns across Marketo and Salesforce, manage the data flowing between them, and partner with every team in marketing to get programs live accurately and on time. Alongside that execution work, you will contribute to how the function scales — helping evaluate new capability in our existing stack, improving the processes behind the work, and building AI\-assisted tooling that makes execution faster and more reliable. This role is ideal for a meticulous, systems\-minded operator who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and takes real pride in work that is built right.

 **What You'll Be Working On:**

* Build and configure Salesforce campaigns end to end — audience and list setup, workflow logic, send scheduling, and campaign hierarchy tagging
* Build, QA, and deploy marketing emails and nurture programs in Marketo, including segmentation, A/B setup, link and UTM checks, and send\-time QA
* Build and maintain Marketo forms embedded on Crusoe\-hosted pages, partnering with the web team on placement, tracking, and field mapping
* Stand up Marketo programs for webinars, field events, and product launches, including templates, tokens, smart campaigns, and channel setup
* Run data and list imports end to end — field mapping, normalization, deduplication etc
* Maintain data hygiene across Marketo and Salesforce, including dedupe rules, field standardization, unsubscribes, and sync error resolution
* Partner with Events, Digital, Content, Brand, Web, and Product Marketing through their planning cycles to scope upcoming campaign, email, and automation work, and direct contractor capacity when volume requires it
* Partner with Revenue Operations and Sales on lead routing, lifecycle stages, and scoring, ensuring marketing\-generated leads are accurately assigned in Salesforce and every data point needed for downstream outreach is captured
* Build AI\-assisted tooling and automated workflows that turn recurring operational work into repeatable, reliable processes the whole team can use
* Help evaluate new functionality across the marketing stack, contribute to scoping and integrating new tools, and improve existing processes as the team scales

 **What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* 5\+ years of marketing operations or marketing automation experience in B2B environments, with a proven track record of hands\-on campaign execution and data management
* Deep, hands\-on Marketo expertise as a primary builder — programs, smart campaigns, tokens, emails, templates, forms, segmentations, lifecycle, and scoring
* Strong working knowledge of Salesforce — campaigns and campaign members, leads versus contacts, reports and list views — and a practical understanding of how the Marketo sync behaves
* Demonstrated experience importing and cleaning marketing data at volume with a high bar for accuracy
* Experience working across a growing, integrated marketing tech stack, with the ability to trace data across connected systems and diagnose where it breaks
* Practical AI fluency, with experience building AI\-assisted tools or automated workflows that support an operations function
* Strong analytical skills, with experience building reporting that stakeholders rely on and turning campaign and funnel data into clear answers
* Experience supporting a wide variety of stakeholders — web, brand, digital, events, content, product marketing, revenue operations, and sales — and translating their requests into executable work
* Exceptional organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing deadlines across many concurrent campaigns
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field; Marketo Certified Expert (MCE) a plus
* Familiarity with our wider marketing stack — Sigma, Knak, Qualified, Webflow, Google Analytics, Workato a plus
* Comfort level with ambiguity and ability to operate both strategically and tactically
* Process to stay on top of and implement the latest developments in marketing automation, martech, and AI tooling

 **Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation and equity packages
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs
* Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account
* Paid parental leave
* Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability
* Professional development \& tuition reimbursement
* Mental health \& wellness support
* Commuter benefits (parking \& transit)
* Cell phone stipend
* 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary
* Volu

It is critical that we operate with an independent and objective perspective and can represent our point of view to our partners and executive stakeholders. We serve as financial advisers to our business partners and own shared business goals and results where appropriate. We strive to balance our responsibility to support business partners with our responsibility to serve the long\-term mission and sustainability of Meta and act as stewards of the company's resources. This role requires strategic thinking, influencing stakeholders through written proposals, data\-driven presentations, and cross\-functional alignment, an analytical mindset, and a bias towards action. You will be challenged to understand and contribute to rapidly changing business models, drive collaboration across teams, develop recommendations on strategic investment decisions, craft annual and long\-term plans, and partner with leaders to solve problems and achieve goals. In this role, you will take on significant responsibility, work directly with product and business leaders, and contribute to decisions that shape Meta's business strategy.

* Oversee A/V setup, testing, and day\-of execution

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

Elex Solutions builds the electrical infrastructure behind California's electrification push — commercial and multi\-family solar, and EV charging. We're hiring a Project Manager / Site Superintendent to own projects including scheduling, crew, and the client relationship.

This is a hybrid desk\-and\-field role. You'll manage the numbers and the paperwork, and you'll be on site often enough to know exactly what's happening in the ground and on the roof. If you like owning a job from award through PTO and closeout, this is that seat.

**What you'll do**

* Run multiple concurrent solar, storage, and EV charging projects across commercial and multi\-family sites
* Own labor hour and material budgets, track cost\-to\-complete, and flag variances before they become write\-offs
* Build and hold the schedule against GC\-set milestones; coordinate with GCs, owners, property managers, EPCs, and trade partners
* Supervise field crews and subcontractors on site — layout, sequencing, quality, and safety
* Manage utility coordination and interconnection with PG\&E and other AHJs: make\-ready, service upgrades, submittals, inspections, PTO
* Keep field documentation current in our project systems and support prevailing wage compliance on public works jobs

**What you need**

* 5\+ years managing or superintending electrical construction, with direct experience on **multi\-family and commercial solar and EV charging installations**
* Working command of NEC plus Title 24 and CALGreen EV\-ready requirements
* Proven track record running budgets and schedules on projects in the $100K–$2M\+ range
* Experience with California utility interconnection and AHJ permitting
* Ability to read and coordinate electrical plans, single\-lines, and submittals
* Strong communication with GCs, owners, and inspectors — you're the face of the job
* Valid California driver's license

**Nice to have**

* California DIR General Electrician certification
* Prevailing wage / public works experience (certified payroll, DIR eCPR, apprentice ratios)
* OSHA 30, NFPA 70E, and EVITP certification

jobs.title: FAA Assistant Program Manager
jobs.description:
Summary
  
The Assistant Program Manager (APM) is responsible for regional oversight and management for the FAA Western Service Area sites. The APM oversees Site Manager (Captains) who are responsible for day\-to\-day operations of their relative site.
  
  

The APM serves as primary field\-level representative between ADC LTD NM Corporate Headquarters (HQ) and Site Management. This role is responsible for ensuring that all assigned sites and Site Managers (Captains) operate safely, efficiently, professionally and in accordance with company policies, union requirements, customer contractual obligations, and applicable laws and regulations.
  
  

This position Reports directly to the Executive Vice President/Program Manager (PM). The Assistant Program Manager will work closely with ADC LTD NM Corporate Executives, the FAA HR team, directly with Government Contracting Officer's Representatives (CORs), Contracting Officer's Technical Representative (COTRs), and Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) site Area Technical Representatives (ATRs).
  
The APM provides operational oversight and support to the Site Captains, Security Officers and site personnel. This position is responsible for maintaining site compliance, monitoring staffing and performance, conducting site inspections, addressing operational issues and ensuring consistent standards across all assigned locations.
  
The APM is expected to maintain a strong, professional field presence while keeping HQ informed of operational conditions, compliance concerns, staffing issues, incidents and client\-related matters. This role communicates regional performance and issues to HQ, and works both independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced, dynamic company.
  
Essential Functions
  
* Provide Management and Oversight of all Site Managers (Captains) and Security Officers at each site under the Western Service Area (WSA) Contract.
* Provide daily guidance and advise Site Managers (Captains) on ADC Corporate requirements, policies, procedures, rights, and obligations under the contract terms.
* Ensure each site it compliant with contract terms, conditions and consistency with ADC LTD NM’s Corporate standards.
* Work with Site Managers (Captains) to ensure Security Officers are following post orders and contractual terms and conditions.
* Ensure Compliance with Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) and FAR supplements and other Government contracting issues.
* Ensure Compliance with Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBA’s), and actively participate in Union negotiations, investigations, charges, disputes, and resolutions to ensure best value for the Government and ADC LTD NM.
* Issues contractual correspondence including evaluating and responding to Government requests.
* Attends meeting and briefings with Government customers and ADC LTD NM Executives including Government quarterly Program Management Review (PMR) preparation and presentation
* Provide input and support for Contractual Price Adjustments, Task Orders, Contractual Funding, Annual Obligations (De\-Obligations) including review and analysis of solicitations for Temporary and Emergency Support Services, terms and conditions determinations
* Ability to address complex Human Resource related matters and recommend solutions to specific staffing and retention challenges.
* Ensure Site Managers (Captains) are effectively managing staffing, scheduling, guard performance, training, client requirements, and daily site operations.
* Conduct regular meetings and performance reviews with Site Managers (Captains).
* Support Site Managers (Captains) in maintaining professional Government and FAA relationships.
* Provide coaching and guidance to Site Managers (Captains).
* Conduct scheduled and unscheduled visits to assigned sites.
* Escalate significate personnel or operational issue to HQ Executive Vice President/Program Manager.
* Perform all other duties and responsibilities related to the position as directed or assigned.


Education, Experience and Skills
  
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in lieu of a degree.
* A minimum of 7 years of managerial physical security experience or similar field; preferably with federal contracts.
* Ability to obtain FAA background vetting through VAP
* Strong understanding of security operations and compliance requirements.
* Strong leadership and accountability skills.
* Excellent communication and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple Site Managers (Captains) and locations simultaneously.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Program/Project Management Skills
* Exercise sound judgment in a politically sensitive environment
* General management consulting skills and ability to interact with clients.
* Ability to handle personally identifiable, sensitive and confidential information.
* Ability to travel between managed sites.


Physical Demands
  
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands and fingers to handle, feel or operate objects, tools or controls, and reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to walk, stand, sit for long periods of time, bend, balance, carry and pull up to 15 lbs., talk, see and hear.
  
  

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work
  
This is a full\-time position. Must be available to address emergencies and incidence(s) for non\-standard hours. Evening and weekend shifts may be required.
  
  

Supervisory Responsibility
  
Supervisor to the Site Captains on the FAA Western Contract.
  
  

Travel
  
This position requires periodic travel to WSA sites on a as needed/scheduled basis.
  
  

Benefits
  
Full benefit package provided by Corporate Human Resources.

jobs.title: Compute Deployment Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About San Francisco Compute**
===============================


San Francisco Compute exists to give ambitious teams large scale supercomputers without taking on a catastrophic balance sheet risk. Most GPU clouds force you to sign long term contracts with no way out. If you underbuy, you miss the window. If you overbuy, you’ll blow up with no way out. It’s a desperate gamble that San Francisco Compute does not force you to play.


Originally, SFC was an AI lab that bought too big of a GPU cluster and was forced to sublease it or go under. Today, we build data centers, supercomputers, and then lease those machines on contracts that let our customers sublease. More than anyone else in the industry, we deeply felt the pain and fear of being forced to bet the farm with your neocloud vendor. To make it possible to sublease, we invented the first compute market and became the first one to offer physical settlement. That means we operate GPU clusters like a neocloud and derisk our customers like a market.


Customers buying GPU clusters don’t want to work through a network of brokers. They want to transact with the folks that have the keys to the cluster and can own the SLA.


To keep the industry safe from unnecessary risk, SFC needs to scale fast. To do that, we serve financially motivated parties as a technical partner to build, operate, \& lease supercomputers on their behalf. Basically, we help folks who want an economic return build GPU clusters on their balance sheet, but operated in full by us. That allows us to retain the technical control needed to operate a cloud, but scale fast like a market. SFC’s ability to offer subleasing can significantly increase the levered returns for cluster owners. Our hybrid model out\-performs brokered contracts or other “compute markets”, who have to go through a network of counterparties to solve problems. It also lets us design custom solutions for our customers, like clusters deployed in regions next to your dataset or physical eval set or a large CPU fleet deployed colocated with your GPU cluster.


Our team includes senior \& technical leadership from places like Lambda, Crusoe, Digital Ocean, AWS, and Hut8\. Our CTO is the cofounder and former CEO of Voltage Park. In prior roles, our team has deployed 8GW of datacenter capacity \& hundreds of thousands of GPUs. We’ve been described as having “the highest talent density in the space.” If you are an honorable, gritty person with eyes wide open \& good epistemics, who wants to see AI go right, we’d love to work with you. There has never been a more critical moment in history and it is up to us to shape it on behalf of those who come after us.

**About The Role**


We're hiring a Deployment Project Manager for the Compute Deals team. This is the person who owns what happens post\-deal signature: standing up clusters, driving them through bring\-up and validation, and carrying them to successful customer delivery. This is not a deal\-sourcing or procurement role, but you will run point on every workstream necessary to execute a compute partnership contract successfully, working with Engineering and GTM until the cluster is live and the customer is running on it.

**What You Will Do**

**Cross\-Functional \& Customer Coordination**

* Serve as the connective tissue between Compute Deal Lead, Engineering, and GTM, translating technical status into clear updates for internal stakeholders
* Coordinate compute provider\-facing and customer\-facing communication on deployment status and timelines, in partnership with Compute Deal Lead and GTM
* Influence technical and operational decisions across teams that don't report to you

**Partner \& Account Management**

* Own internal and external partner communication for every active deployment, keeping customers, providers, and internal stakeholders aligned on status, timelines, and next steps
* Coordinate directly with the Head of Compute Deals on contract handover, making sure deal terms, commitments, and customer context carry cleanly into the deployment phase
* Flag account\-level risks or opportunities back to the Head of Compute Deals early, so the deal team can get ahead of them

**Process \& Reporting**

* Run tight, recurring reporting on deployment stages, blockers, and upcoming milestones. This includes building dashboard, trackers, and standups
* Drive better handoffs from deal teams into deployment, tightening the contract\-to\-kickoff transition

**Deployment Ownership**

* Own end\-to\-end program execution for signed compute deals, from contract handoff through rack\-and\-stack, bring\-up, validation, and customer go\-live
* Lead multiple concurrent GPU cluster deployments at varying stages, sequencing dependencies across hardware delivery, site readiness, networking, and software bring\-up
* Define delivery milestones and acceptance criteria for each deployment, and hold the team to them

**BOM \& Technical Validation**

* Read and reconcile Bills of Materials against contracted specs, catching mismatches, substitutions, or non\-standard components
* Work directly with Engineering to understand rack configurations, node specs, and network topology well enough to ask the right technical questions, not just relay them

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 3\+ years in technical program or project management. Ideally in data center, infrastructure, hardware, telecom but not required
* A track record of managing complex, multi\-stakeholder programs over months, not days
* Excellent cross\-functional communication; equally credible with hardware engineers and commercial/deal leads
* High ownership and bias to action, comfortable escalating early rather than waiting for a problem to resolve itself

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Fluency in GPU/compute infrastructure terminology (NVL72, HGX, DGX, InfiniBand, rack/node topology)
* Demonstrated ability to read and work with a Bill of Materials; you understand rack configurations, node specs, and networking co

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Bruno, CA, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience leading operations in technology, management consulting, or vendor management environments.
* Experience managing programs, vendor operations, and cross\-functional teams.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Ability to influence cross\-functionally within a complex, matrixed organization.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate and be effective under pressure, with a knack for coaching teams to navigate and communicate within ambiguous environments.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, paired with problem\-solving capabilities.
* Background in Trust and Safety, content moderation, or policy operations within online platforms.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Global Vendor Operations organization manages vendor partner ecosystems across all of YouTube. These vendors provide support to all YouTube users—viewers, paid subscribers, and creators, artists, and media companies worldwide, across all YouTube products.  

  

As a Governance Lead within YouTube Trust and Safety, you will ensure initiatives are executed seamlessly. You will serve as the primary bridge between senior leaders and front\-line execution teams. Additionally, you will oversee supplier delivery, regulatory compliance, and cross\-functional synergy to maintain YouTube as a safe, fair, and reliable platform for the global community.At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $164000 \- $239000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Synthesize complex operational data into concise briefings and executive summaries for executive leadership, highlighting insights, key metrics, and operational risks while delivering actionable recommendations based on deep dives.
* Facilitate recurring weekly and monthly governance reviews to closely monitor vendor performance, maintain strong operational alignment, and proactively identify and mitigate emerging operational risks.
* Refine monthly vendor scorecards to ensure accurate tracking against key performance indicators and benchmarks, while preparing thorough materials that establish clear partner accountability and operational alignment.
* Establish standardized operational frameworks and consistent guidelines for content moderation workflows and user appeals to systematically optimize processing speed, decision accuracy, quality, and platform performance.
* Perform advanced quantitative analyses to resolve critical operational questions and direct initiatives that enhance system efficiency, delivering measurable, sustainable performance improvements across all global YouTube business operations.

jobs.title: Field Project Manager – Travel Position
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

At **Utilities One**, we are driven by innovation, operational excellence, and a commitment to building the future of critical infrastructure. As a trusted turnkey solutions provider across **telecom, power, water, renewable energy, and data center** sectors, we deliver high\-quality services that connect and empower communities. In addition to our core operations, we offer **specialized consulting services** that help our clients design, optimize, and execute complex infrastructure projects with confidence and precision. We believe our greatest strength is our people — a team of dedicated professionals who bring expertise, collaboration, and integrity to everything they do. Join us and become part of a growing organization where your contributions make a meaningful impact.  

  

We are looking for a qualified **Field Project Manager** to support construction projects across the **Western U.S. market**. This travel\-based role requires flexibility and frequent travel to various project locations.  

The **Field Project Manager** is responsible for daily field execution, vendor oversight, and operational coordination of assigned construction projects, ensuring crews and subcontractors are prepared, compliant, and aligned with client and company standards.  

As the on\-site operational leader, this position coordinates field teams, vendors, management, clients, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are executed **safely, efficiently, and according to approved plans and requirements**.  

### **Key Responsibilities**

 **Project Review \& Pre\-Construction Readiness*** Review assigned projects for scope, constructability, and sequencing.
* Conduct pre\-construction walkouts with vendors and internal teams.
* Verify locate ticket status and ensure valid locates are in place prior to excavation.
* Issue required 48\-hour notices.
* Coordinate specialty services as needed (GPR, core drilling, line adjustments, FDOT scheduling, etc.).
* Confirm permits, traffic control requirements (MOT), and jurisdictional approvals are secured before work begins.
* Identify potential field conflicts early and coordinate resolution with engineering and management.

**Daily Field Coordination \& Vendor Oversight*** Meet with foremen/vendors daily to review work plans, expectations, and job sequencing.
* Monitor GPM check\-ins and ensure production is accurately entered and updated.
* Ensure vendors and crews:
	+ Have required documentation and certifications
	+ Are properly equipped for assigned work
	+ Follow approved construction methods and specifications
* Verify proper crew assignment based on work type (aerial, underground, boring).
* Enforce approved work\-hour restrictions per jurisdiction.
* Confirm crews are working in logical order aligned with locates and permits.
* Coordinate daily MOT needs and communicate requirements to management.

**Field Execution, Quality \& Compliance*** Conduct ongoing site inspections to verify quality and adherence to plans.
* Ensure compliance with:
	+ Required drilling practices (potholing, drain sock use, proper depths, DAP procedures, etc.)
	+ Underground depth requirements
	+ Aerial attachment standards and HOA requirements
	+ Safety regulations and PPE compliance
* Perform QA/QC checks on assigned projects.
* Ensure restoration requirements are completed properly.
* Confirm timely completion of assigned production units (“gigs”).

**Troubleshooting \& Issue Resolution*** Serve as the first\-line problem solver for field challenges.
* Assist crews in resolving technical issues and unexpected conditions.
* Coordinate map discrepancies and field changes with engineering.
* Investigate and report damages; assist with resolution and documentation.
* Maintain proactive communication when plans require adjustment.
* Escalate critical concerns to OPM or Director when necessary.

**Reporting \& Documentation*** Submit required daily and project reporting including:
	+ End\-of\-shift reports (EOS)
	+ Damage reports
	+ MOT updates
	+ QA/QC documentation
* Keep GPM updated with production, rejections, corrections, and completions.
* Ensure project documentation is accurate and submitted in a timely manner.

**Stakeholder Communication \& Representation*** Communicate daily with management, clients, cities, and jurisdictions as required.
* Attend coordination meetings when assigned.
* Relay updates, expectations, and changes to field crews promptly.
* Address homeowner or public concerns professionally and coordinate resolution.
* Represent the company as the on\-site operational leader.

**Resource \& Operational Support*** Monitor material availability and notify OPM when inventory is insufficient.
* Ensure traffic control requests are submitted and executed properly.
* Support yard organization and equipment readiness.
* Assist in developing field crews through training and reinforcement of standards.

**Authority \& Accountability**  

The Field Project Management / Field Project Manager is accountable for:* Daily field execution and productivity
* Vendor and crew compliance with construction standards
* Safety and permit adherence
* Accurate reporting and documentation
* Timely completion of assigned production goals

Other duties as assigned.### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* A valid, unrestricted **Driver’s License;**
* Strong knowledge of **field construction, vendor management, and project coordination**;
* Ability to read and understand **construction plans, drawings, maps, and diagrams**;
* Strong communication, organizational, and problem\-solving skills;
* Ability to work independently and effectively coordinate **crews, subcontractors, vendors, and other stakeholders**;
* Ability to work outdoors and in varying weather conditions;
* Willingness and ability to **travel frequently to different project sites throughout the Western U.S. market**.

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Health Insurance plans (health, dental, vision);

**Secondary Skills (Good\-to\-Have)**


* **Data Architecture Familiarity:** Experience with Cloud Data Platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), Data Warehousing, Data Lakes, and Master Data Management (MDM).
* **Data Governance:** Familiarity with Data Governance frameworks, tools, and data privacy standards relevant to Life Sciences.
* **Certifications:** PMP, PgMP, PMI\-ACP, Scrum Master, or equivalent project credentials.
* **Global Delivery:** Experience managing and collaborating with globally distributed teams and third\-party vendors.
  

  

**Job Description \& Role Overview**


**Role Summary**


We are seeking an experienced **Technical Project Manager** with **10\+ years of experience** to lead and support Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) integrations for a global Life Sciences organization. This role is critical for an onshore customer account and requires an independent leader to drive the planning, execution, governance, and successful delivery of a comprehensive data strategy roadmap.


**Key Responsibilities (What You'll Do)**


* **End\-to\-End Delivery:** Lead Data Strategy, Data Transformation initiatives, and manage Data Lake Sprints.
* **Integration Support:** Drive the integration of Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS) with other core ecosystems.
* **Project Governance:** Develop project plans, manage resource allocations, and meticulously maintain RAID logs.
* **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Align Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Analytics, and Business Intelligence teams.
* **Requirements \& Testing:** Lead requirements refinement (current/future state analysis), own User Acceptance Testing (UAT) planning, and partner with Validation teams to ensure compliance.
* **Compliance Assurance:** Ensure all project activities strictly adhere to Life Sciences regulatory frameworks and GxP standards.
* **Status Reporting:** Facilitate stakeholder workshops and deliver weekly project health reports to leadership.

**Soft Skills**


* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal, email, and instant messaging skills tailored for internal teams and client stakeholders.
* **Interpersonal:** Ability to give and receive constructive feedback during code/technical reviews and build productive relationships.
* **Problem\-Solving:** Analytical mindset equipped to troubleshoot and resolve bottlenecks efficiently.

**What Success Looks Like (612 Months)**


* Successfully executing key milestones of the Data Strategy roadmap on schedule and within budget.
* Establishing a structured governance model, including steering committees and executive reporting channels.
* Strengthening data governance processes and ensuring full alignment with organizational regulatory and GxP standards.

**Job Summary**


The **Senior Project Manager (SPM)** manages the Project Management Team to ensure that large, complex projects are planned, implemented, and completed in accordance with the client’s strategic business goals and objectives. The Senior Project Manager, reporting to Account Manager, will be responsible for the delivery of a portfolio of projects in accordance with the PMO. They will review and report contract performance and associated reporting across all services performed for the constituent projects of the account. The Senior Project Manager will review, analyze, and help prepare project dashboard information periodically and will reconcile any issues or discrepancies to provide to the PMO.

* This position is required to be on\-site a minimum of 4 days a week.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Project Management Compliance
* Set clear goals and objectives for project planning, implementation, and delivery for the entire lifecycle of multiple projects occurring simultaneously.
* Understand and communicate program changes during the PMO lifecycle, training project team leaders as necessary and updating project\-level dashboards and document templates for project team use.
* Project Planning, Implementation, and Delivery
* Understand and communicate established key performance indicators for the PMO and work with project teams to incorporate KPIs into overall project plans.
* Host project\-level meetings with all project teams and stakeholders. Create, record, and memorialize all meeting agendas, minutes, and documents.
* Define and track program scope, including all constituent projects, activities associated with the program, governance for financial performance, risk analysis and mitigation.
* Initiate, develop and review project team schedules and align with the overall PMO master schedule.
* Represent any project\-level highlights, issues or risks that affect PMO performance at the PMO meetings.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Business, Construction Management, Engineering or similar.
* 15\+ years’ experience in the tenant advisory, development, architecture, engineering, or construction management.
* MCR, PgPM, or PMP certification(s) preferred.
* High level of process and problem\-solving skills in ambiguous environment. Strong analytic abilities, consistent and methodical in reporting, anticipates risks and issues.

Sunnyvale, California, United States


**Category** General Management **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18753 **Base Salary Range** $117000\-$176000 **Date posted** 09/15/2026
### **We Are**


Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You have spent years turning ambiguity into action, and you know the difference between a program that runs itself and one that needs constant rescue. The work that excites you is not the big announcement, it is the mechanism behind it: the review that surfaces the right decision, the tracker that keeps ten leaders aligned, the agenda that turns a two\-hour meeting into a thirty\-minute one with clear next steps.


You are the person who walks into a room where three teams think they are aligned and quietly realizes they are not, then fixes it without drama. You do not need perfect information to move. You ask the right questions, map what matters, and build the structure that lets other people do their best work. When a senior leader says "we need to get our arms around this," you are already drafting the plan.


You have run operating rhythms before, not just participated in them. You know what makes a quarterly business review actually useful versus performative. You are comfortable holding a VP to a deadline and equally comfortable absorbing the work no one else sees. At Synopsys, you will work directly with the Chief IP Development Office and own the programs that keep two major engineering organizations moving forward.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Own the full lifecycle of strategic programs across IPG and SSG, from scoping and planning through execution and closure, including tracking milestones, dependencies, and commitments across leadership
* Run the operating rhythm of the Executive Office: strategic account reviews, staff meetings, all\-hands forums, quarterly business reviews, and leadership check\-ins, including agenda design, pre\-reads, minutes, action tracking, and follow\-up
* Build and maintain dashboards, status reports, and executive summaries that leadership uses to track progress and make decisions, working across teams to ensure consistency and accuracy
* Prepare the CIDO and leadership team for reviews and planning cycles by assembling agendas, data, and materials that are clear, accurate, and ready to use
* Drive cross\-functional action items to closure, coordinating across engineering, product management, finance, and HR to keep commitments on track
* Improve how the office operates by refining existing mechanisms and standing up new ones as the organization scales
* Partner with the CIDO's Executive Assistant on scheduling, logistics, and day\-to\-day coordination for leadership meetings, off\-sites, and large events across multiple time zones

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Leadership decisions move faster and with better information because the reviews you run surface the right data at the right time
* Cross\-organizational commitments close on schedule because you track them, follow up, and hold owners accountable without letting things slip
* Senior leaders spend less time chasing status and more time on strategy because the reporting you build is consistent, accurate, and easy to consume
* The Executive Office becomes a model for how an engineering organization should operate, with mechanisms that scale as IPG and SSG grow
* Programs that would otherwise stall in ambiguity move forward because you bring structure, clarity, and follow\-through
* The CIDO and leadership team are prepared for every review, every planning cycle, and every decision point because you have done the work to make them ready

jobs.title: Customer Experience & Quality Manager
jobs.description:
**About ArtHaus Properties**### **The expanded ArtHaus Properties operating company is a wholly owned subsidiary of Arthaus Partners, purpose\-built to manage and scale our vertically integrated residential platform. This role offers a rare opportunity to help shape the future of operations at a company on the verge of doubling its footprint, bringing structure, innovation, and excellence to a portfolio with significant near\-term growth ahead. It’s an exciting moment to lead, build, and leave your mark.**

**Position Summary**
--------------------


ArtHaus Properties is seeking a Customer Experience \& Quality Manager to create a consistent, high\-quality resident experience across our portfolio.


This role owns the design, visibility, quality control and continuous improvement of the company’s Resident Request Resolution process. The manager ensures that every resident request is captured, assigned, monitored, communicated and properly closed—and that recurring failures are identified and corrected.


The role also provides independent quality control over the physical resident experience, including property appearance, common\-area conditions, move\-in readiness and other points where residents interact with an ArtHaus property.


Regional Managers and Property Managers remain accountable for resolving resident issues and delivering property\-level results. The Customer Experience \& Quality Manager owns the integrity and effectiveness of the process used to produce those results.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Resident Request Resolution Process**

* Own and continuously improve the companywide Resident Request Resolution workflow.
* Ensure resident requests from all approved channels enter the designated system of record.
* Establish consistent request categories, priority levels, response standards, resolution targets and escalation rules.
* Ensure every request has a named responsible person, required next action and target completion date.
* Monitor open, overdue, unassigned and high\-risk resident requests across the portfolio.
* Confirm that residents receive timely acknowledgment, status updates and resolution communications.
* Establish documentation and evidence requirements for closing resident requests.
* Audit closed requests to confirm that the underlying issue was resolved and communicated appropriately.
* Return incomplete or improperly closed requests for additional action.
* Escalate unresolved or repeatedly delayed matters to the appropriate Regional Manager and, when necessary, the President.
* Identify recurring complaints, process breakdowns and systemic service issues.

### **Customer Experience Standards**

* Develop and maintain ArtHaus standards for resident communication and service.
* Define the expected resident experience at critical touchpoints, including move\-in, maintenance requests, complaints, property notices and issue resolution.
* Review resident communications for clarity, professionalism, empathy, accuracy and consistency.
* Develop templates, playbooks and service\-recovery standards for common resident situations.
* Partner with operating leaders to provide training and coaching on customer\-experience expectations.
* Gather resident feedback and translate it into practical operational improvements.
* Identify situations in which an issue may be technically completed but the resident experience remains unresolved.

### **Physical Experience and Property Quality Control**

* Develop practical quality standards for the physical resident experience.
* Conduct scheduled and unannounced property\-quality reviews across the portfolio.
* Inspect resident\-facing areas, including building entrances, lobbies, hallways, elevators, laundry rooms, mail and package areas, trash areas, exterior conditions, signage and other common spaces.
* Review move\-in\-ready units from the resident’s perspective.
* Evaluate cleanliness, appearance, functionality, safety presentation and consistency with ArtHaus standards.
* Document deficiencies with photographs, ownership assignments and corrective\-action deadlines.
* Verify that identified deficiencies are corrected—not merely marked complete.
* Track recurring physical\-quality issues by property, region, category and responsible function.
* Coordinate with Regional Managers, Property Managers and Maintenance leadership while preserving their accountability for execution.
* Recommend improvements to inspection standards, property routines and preventive\-quality controls.

### **Quality Assurance and Process Control**

* Develop a risk\-based quality\-assurance program covering resident requests and physical property conditions.
* Audit a defined sample of open and closed resident requests each week.
* Monitor adherence to response, communication, documentation and closure standards.
* Identify workflow failures, unclear handoffs and requests that fall between departments.
* Conduct root\-cause reviews for recurring complaints, reopened cases and serious service failures.
* Facilitate corrective\-action plans with the responsible operating leader.
* Verify whether corrective actions produced sustained improvement.
* Maintain consistent quality standards across properties and regions.

### **Reporting and Performance Management**

* Build and maintain a portfolio\-level customer\-experience and quality scorecard.
* Report performance by property, region, request category and responsible function.

jobs.title: Community Health Worker - CHW III
jobs.description:
Join **Bay Area Community Health** as a **full\-time Community Health Worker \- CHW III** to help a mission\-focused organization provide even better support to people in need.


Not only will you complete meaningful work while earning **$27\.08 \- $31\.39/hour** (based on qualifications), but you'll also enjoy:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Life insurance and short\- and long\-term disability
* FSA and dependent care
* 403(b) retirement plan
* PTO and paid holidays
* Commuter program spending account and a scrubs allowance
* Employee wellness programs and a loan repayment program


Keep reading to learn how you can make a difference with our Fremont, CA organization!

 **COMMUNITY HEALTH WORKER \- CHW III QUALIFICATIONS**


The ideal fit is a compassionate, mission\-driven person who wants to go above and beyond for the populations we serve. We would prefer someone with 2\+ years of community\-based healthcare service experience, an AA/AS in a field related to health, and bilingual communication skills. What matters most is that you have:

* Current CHW certification and CEC certification (if applicable)
* Ability to complete timely recertification and retraining processes
* Ability to travel to various BACH locations, such as clinics, schools, homes, warming centers, homeless encampments, and patient appointments, and work outside in various weather
* Ability to complete physical tasks like using a computer/keyboard, moving up to 50 lbs., and other duties typical of an office environment
* High school diploma or GED

 **A DAY IN THE LIFE**


Standard work hours are **Monday \- Friday, 8:00 am \- 5:00 pm**.


Our Community Health Worker \- CHW III supports our dedicated team in serving clients' needs by helping expand access to resources, developing a network of community partners, and training other CHWs on our processes and industry best practices. You'll coordinate internal, external, and online training for staff members and monitor their productivity to ensure everyone's doing the best they can for clients. Outside of internal development, you'll proactively research, contact, and strengthen connections with local healthcare providers, specialists, and grant\-funded programs. By developing these partnerships, you'll help increase our clients' access to and knowledge of invaluable resources.


In all your work activities, you'll make sure to follow HIPAA regulations, comply with BACH guidelines, and support continuous improvement following the PDSA model. The Community Health Worker \- CHW III also evaluates clients' living situations and performs thorough housing, crisis, intake, and SDOH assessments to properly identify needs and determine the appropriate steps to take. You'll respond to information requests, help address and resolve complex issues, and prepare sensitive/confidential correspondence when needed. Assisting in other areas as assigned, you'll help strengthen our team, broaden available support services, and make a lasting positive impact!

 **HELP US MAKE A DIFFERENCE!**


If you're passionate about caring for people and want to advance your healthcare career, join Bay Area Community Health! As one of the largest Federally Qualified Health Centers in Northern California, we serve over 100,000 patients each year at 20\+ locations from Union City to Gilroy.

**OUR VIBRANT CULTURE**


Our diverse team is committed to delivering exceptional care and making a meaningful impact in our communities. We offer a dynamic and empowering work environment that values innovation, professional development, and the unique contributions of each employee. Become part of our team today!


Apply for a full\-time position by completing our short initial application!

jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**



The Regional Customer Support Specialist, known internally as a Territory Manager, supports Natera's division and provides world class service to customers consisting of medical professionals, patients and cross functional internal and external teams. This position primarily consists of working with customers and sales representatives to ensure a smooth ordering process and quick reporting of results. Requires ability to work independently, multi\-task, and use critical thinking skills to resolve issues in a timely manner.

  


**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Respond promptly to internal and external customer inquiries.
* Serve as the lead contact for accounts and Sales and document all interactions, communications, actions taken, and follow ups.
* Build rapport with accounts, patients and Sales to resolve missing information in a timely manner, ensuring TAT is met.

* Familiarity with all oncology tests performed by Natera, including samples needed, TAT to results, all required patient health information, proper completion of request forms, and required waivers.

* Two year degree and/or 2\-5 years of related experience, undergraduate degree preferred.
* Skilled specialist, completes tasks in a resourceful and efficient manner.
* Advanced professional growth education.

When you join Natera, you'll work hard and grow quickly.
