jobs.title: Patient Services Specialist
jobs.description:
**Be the first point of care—guiding patients through admission with accuracy, compassion, and confidence while ensuring every detail of their visit is handled seamlessly.**



At SimonMed Imaging, the patient experience starts long before an exam takes place. Our Patient Service Specialists play a critical role in facilitating the patient admission flow across our imaging centers. From greeting patients to verifying insurance and processing documentation, this role ensures each visit starts with clarity, efficiency, and care.



We are looking for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, communicates with empathy, and takes pride in delivering exceptional service. If you enjoy helping people, solving problems, and being part of a collaborative healthcare team, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact every day.


### **What You Bring**

**A patient\-first mindset:** You treat every interaction with empathy, respect, and genuine concern for patient needs.


**Strong communication and team\-oriented approach:** You communicate clearly, listen actively, support patients and teams with professionalism and empathy, and contribute to smooth, collaborative front desk operations.


**Attention to detail:** You accurately collect, process, and maintain patient demographics, insurance information, medical histories, consent forms, and payments with accuracy and care.


**Adaptability and composure:** You stay calm under pressure in high\-volume environments, manage competing priorities, and handle sensitive or challenging situations with professionalism.


**Reliability, accountability, and problem\-solving:** You take ownership of your work, follow through on commitments, consistently arrive prepared and ready to support the team, contribute to a positive culture, and help resolve scheduling, billing, and patient flow issues while maintaining a positive patient experience.

### **What You'll Gain**

**Purpose\-driven work:** Your role is essential to patient care, ensuring every individual is welcomed, supported, and guided through a smooth and compassionate access experience from the very start of their visit.


**A collaborative team environment:** Partner with clinical, operational, and support teams focused on delivering exceptional patient experiences.


**Growth opportunities:** Gain experience in healthcare operations, patient access, and medical administration within a growing organization.

### **You're a Strong Fit if You Have**

* 1\+ years of customer service, patient access, medical office, or call center experience preferred


* Experience with scheduling, insurance verification, or healthcare registration processes preferred


* Strong computer and data entry skills


* Ability to multitask in a fast\-paced environment


* Excellent verbal and written communication skills


* Experience working with EMR/PM systems preferred


* High school diploma or equivalent required

### **Benefits**



Your health, happiness and future matters!



At SimonMed Imaging, we offer:


* We believe in preventative care for everyone including our team – SimonMed provides free, whole\-body scans to each member


* Competitive wages


* No nights/no calls/no weekends


* Cross training opportunities


* Medical, dental, and vision insurance


* 401(k) eligibility


* Pet Insurance


* Paid holidays


* PTO


* Sick Time



We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of drug and background screening. Some positions will require a favorable driving record.

jobs.description:
**Company Description** **About AbbVie**


AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience \- and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

 **Job Description**  

The Clinical Data Strategy and Operations (CDSO) DMO Lead or Clinical Data Scientist (CDS) serves as the data management domain expert and key strategic partner to the clinical study team. This role owns the data collection strategy, drives implementation, oversees data quality delivery, and supports on\-time achievement of key study milestones. As the Data Operations single point of contact for cross\-functional stakeholders, the DMO Lead or CDS applies strong project management, risk oversight, and continuous process optimization to enable data quality, inspection readiness, and successful trial delivery.


Responsibilities:

* Serves as the CDSO data management subject matter expert and single point of contact for assigned studies, owning data collection, data cleaning, and database lock strategies to enable high\-quality, inspection\-ready study delivery.
* Leads risk\-based and continuous data review strategies from study start\-up through database lock, leveraging centralized monitoring, statistical review, and clinical data science methodologies to proactively identify and mitigate study risks.
* Triages data quality standards across studies to identify trends, drive site\-level actions through effective cross\-functional communication, and maintain data currency in support of timely, reliable study decisions.
* Interprets clinical and operational data, quality metrics, predictive signals, and dashboard outputs to develop data\-driven recommendations that strengthen study execution, risk management, patient safety oversight, and quality across the clinical development lifecycle.
* Contributes to defining, managing, and monitoring data\-driven protocol deviations.
* Defines and manages study data flow and triages issues from raw EDC data through mapped SDTM data, partnering with internal technology teams, service providers, and vendors to drive timely mitigation and support end\-to\-end data integrity.
* Performs data mining and custom analytics, gathers business requirements for study dashboards, and generates operational metrics that support study decisions.
* Ensures adherence to federal and applicable local regulations, Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), ICH Guidelines, AbbVie SOPs, and functional quality standards; stays abreast of evolving guidance.
* Influences cross\-functional stakeholders without direct authority, aligning clinical, statistical, medical, safety, regulatory, technology, and vendor organizations around data\-driven decisions and clinical data science strategies.
* Leads CDSO innovation and process improvement initiatives and participates in cross\-functional efforts that improve operational effectiveness, scalability, and study delivery quality.
* Coaches and mentors team members.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in business, management information systems, computer science, life sciences or equivalent. Masters preferred.
* Must have 6\+ years of pharma / clinical research / data management / health care experience or 8\+ years of project management experience (and / or applicable work experience).
* In\-depth understanding of clinical trial processes and clinical technology. Management of a clinical trial from initiation through to completion in a lead role is preferred.
* Demonstrated performance as a functional leader
* Demonstrated ability to influence others without direct authority
* Demonstrated ability to successfully coach / mentor in a matrix environment
* Demonstrated effective communication skills
* Demonstrated effective analytical skills

  

**Additional Information**

jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------



DoorDash for Business is building the premier corporate dining and benefits platform—helping companies of all sizes feed their teams through industry\-leading products and meal programs. Our mission is to become the go\-to solution for executives, administrators, and employees who need seamless, high\-quality food programs at work. We move fast, operate with an ownership mindset, and are growing new product lines to better serve our corporate customers.


**About the Role**
------------------



As a Strategy \& Operations Senior Associate for DoorDash for Business, you'll be at the center of piloting and scaling product features that transform delivery quality, making sure every order arrives on time, accurate, properly labeled, and backed by strong options when something goes wrong. You'll shape the experience for clients, dashers, and merchants across the entire journey, not just one piece of it. This is a build\-and\-launch role: you'll partner cross\-functionally to design testing frameworks and go\-to\-market plans, then turn insights from our core audiences into real product improvements. Expect to wear a lot of hats, from support and analytics to close partnership with product, often all in the same week.



You will report into the Manager, Strategy \& Operations for DoorDash for Business and can work remotely or hybrid depending preference.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* **Experiment** – Use data\-driven decision\-making and sound business judgment to run tests and lead product/ feature improvement efforts
* **Optimize** – Partner with product and engineering teams to continually sharpen the tools that drive quality
* **Analyze** – Build models that evaluate economics and patterns, turning data into clear decisions
* **Execute** \- Design and run test plans and initiatives that measurably improve merchant and dasher quality
* **Collaborate** – Work across sales, partner management, operations, product, engineering, and business development to elevate the experience for merchants, dashers, and clients alike

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------


* You have 3\+ years of experience in strategy and operations, commercial management, operations, or consulting; direct management experience, high\-growth startup (scaling a business from 0 \- 1\) experience is preferred
* You have a proven track record of leading cross\-functional initiatives, hitting goals, and succeeding in a complex and fast moving environment
* You are an excellent analytical thinker who can deliver actionable recommendations out of complex datasets; intermediate SQL experience strongly preferred
* You are customer obsessed \- whether that is our clients, merchants or dashers and comfort talking / working with people from all walks of life
* You're unafraid of ambiguity. You don't need a playbook. You dive into difficult problems and come up with a plan. Rapid change and learning is exciting to you.

**About DoorDash**
------------------



At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  

  

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.


**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------



We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.



Statement of Non\-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on "protected categories," we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non\-binary or gender non\-conforming, LGBTQIA\+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently\-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non\-discrimination.



Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.

AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. As a Senior TAM, you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers’ adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.

About AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

#### **About the Job:**



The Manager of Digital Customer Success will report to the Director of Customer Success, Americas, and lead a team of Digital CSMs who serve as the primary post\-sale point of contact for LaunchDarkly's largest subset of customers. The ideal candidate is a people\-first leader who is passionate about delivering an exceptional customer experience, brings an innovative approach to Customer Success, and thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment. This role is a unique opportunity to shape and lead a team in a growing market at LaunchDarkly, driving both customer success and organizational growth.


#### **Responsibilities:**


* **Team Leadership and Development:** Recruit, lead, and develop a high\-performing team of CSMs. Provide ongoing coaching, support, and feedback to help the team grow their skills, deliver strong customer outcomes, and consistently meet or exceed expectations.
* **Scaled Strategy and Execution:** Partner closely with the GTM ecosystem and other CS teams to build and operationalize Customer Success programs and playbooks tailored to the Digital customer segment, ensuring alignment with our global CS frameworks.
* **Proactive Customer Insight:** Enable the team to understand and act early on leading indicators such as onboarding progress, product adoption, risk signals, and expansion potential, in order to reduce churn and drive growth.
* **Operational Execution:** Bring operational rigor to the team by organizing around key performance metrics, including NDR and expansion, and running regular forecast and pipeline reviews to ensure we deliver against both short\- and long\-term goals.
* **Customer Engagement:** Serve as the senior advocate for strategic and high\-impact customers. Oversee critical engagements and escalations, and ensure customer needs and insights inform internal decisions. LaunchDarkly is a startup environment, and everyone stays close to customers.

#### **About You:**


* **Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high\-performing teams.
* **Entrepreneurial Spirit:** Driven, proactive, and comfortable operating in a highly ambiguous, startup environment.
* **Passion for Growth (your own, and your teams):** Enthusiastic about continuous learning and personal development. Actively seeks and provides feedback. You consider promoting a team member the best deal you could possibly close!
* **Analytical:** Enjoys identifying trends in data and making informed decisions about team and customer outcomes.
* **Program Builder:** Passionate about building high\-impact, customer focused programs. Able to build and execute a project plan, holding stakeholders accountable to a timeline.
* **Sales oriented:** You have experience owning a number and want to continue to do so. Customer Success at LaunchDarkly is a commercial function, you should be excited about having commercial responsibility.
* **Problem Solver:** Strong critical thinking skills and enjoys solving complex customer problems.
* **Team Player:** Collaborates well with others, knows when to involve other stakeholders, and proactively keeps others informed.

#### **Qualifications:**

* **Commercial Acumen:** Experience owning the renewal process and being accountable for a retention quota. Strong discovery, qualification, and sales skills; training in Command of the Message, MEDDIC, or similar methodologies is preferred.
* **Data Orientation:** Experience leveraging data to make decisions about talent, team effectiveness, customer programs, etc.
* **Program Development:** Background in building scalable programs to positively impact broad cohorts of customers, leveraging signals and fine\-tuned collateral
* **AI Fluency:** Comfortable leveraging AI to scale the impact of proven processes and tools, while ensuring our customers are provided accurate and actionable insights
* **Technical Knowledge:** Experience working with technical products, preferably within the DevOps space, and interacting with developers or technical personas.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------



Join Anthropic's Customer Success team in a high\-visibility \& high\-impact role driving AI adoption across a small number of enterprise accounts in our Enterprise Tech segment. As our dedicated Customer Success Manager for Enterprise Tech Customers you’ll be their partner and trusted advisor helping them harness the full potential of all our Claude capabilities \- API, Claude Code, Cowork, and other surface areas.



You'll work with a book of global technology leaders to actively deploy AI and reshape the technology landscape. jobs.description:

Peninsula Counseling and Consulting, Inc. has been a pillar of the community since 2016, striving to destigmatize mental health and co\-occurring disorders through evidence\-based, uniquely tailored support.

We are seeking a Licensed Case Manager / Behavioral Health Clinician to join our team in providing high\-impact, community\-based care coordination and skill\-building services in **San Rafael, Tiburon, Sausalito, Mill Valley and surrounding areas .** 

**Position Overview**

In this role, you will work directly with individuals and families in their homes and community settings to foster independence and improve quality of life. This is a part\-time, non\-exempt W\-2 position offering exceptional flexibility and highly competitive compensation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Clinical Assessment \& Intervention:** Monitor client functioning, conduct reality\-testing, and perform solution\-focused interventions for clients with severe and persistent mental illness.
* **Safety \& Crisis Management:** Identify and intervene in high\-risk situations, including thoughts of self\-harm or inability to meet basic needs.

* **Collaboration:** Liaise with family members, medical providers, and stakeholders to ensure seamless care coordination.
* **Documentation:** Maintain precise records within the Electronic Health Record (EHR) using measurement\-based care to track progress.

**Qualifications \& Skills**

We are looking for an experienced professional who exudes cultural humility and has a passion for serving marginalized populations.

* **Education:** Master’s degree or higher in Psychology, Social Work, or Counseling.

* **Mobility:** Valid California driver’s license, acceptable driving record, and access to a personal vehicle for community travel (with required insurance coverage).
* **Technical Proficiency**: Comfortable navigating EHR systems and mobile technology.

Mileage and clinical expense reimbursements

This position is primarily community\-based, requiring independent travel to client homes and congregate settings. Applicants must be comfortable navigating diverse residential environments and responding to urgent clinical needs with autonomy and professional judgment.

**PRIMARY FUNCTIONS:** The Project Manager leads electrical distribution projects from award through closeout. The role is accountable for safety, scope, schedule, cost, quality, client communication, and profitable delivery.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

**PROJECT PLANNING \& EXECUTION:**

* Lead assigned projects from estimating handoff and kickoff through completion, closeout, and final acceptance.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, cost codes, staffing plans, procurement plans, and key milestones.
* Coordinate labor, equipment, materials, subcontractors, permits, outages, and utility interfaces before work begins.
* Maintain three\-to\-six\-week look\-ahead schedules and confirm that crews have current plans, materials, and work packages.
* Manage scope changes, delays, differing site conditions, and recovery plans before they affect safety, cost, or schedule.

**FINANCIAL \& CONTRACT MANAGEMENT:**

* Review daily reports, timecards, equipment usage, purchase commitments, and job\-cost reports for accuracy.
* Maintain cost\-to\-complete forecasts and communicate projected margin, cash, and risk changes to leadership.
* Prepare accurate progress billings, revenue support, and collection documentation by customer deadlines.
* Identify, price, document, submit, and negotiate change orders and time\-and\-material work.
* Track production against estimate assumptions and correct labor or equipment productivity shortfalls.
* Control subcontractor and vendor commitments, invoices, releases, and performance; complete financial reconciliation and closeout promptly.

**SAFETY QUALITY \& COMPLIANCE:**

* Enforce company, OSHA, DOT, and customer safety requirements on every assigned project.
* Support preconstruction hazard reviews, field observations, incident investigations, and corrective actions.
* Verify required briefings, permits, inspections, testing, workmanship, and closeout documentation.

**CLIENT \& OPERATIONAL COORDINATION:**

* Serve as the primary day\-to\-day client contact and lead project meetings with clear action items.
* Coordinate with utilities, inspectors, owners, engineers, municipalities, and other contractors.
* Maintain current logs for schedules, material status, submittals, requests for information, risks, and decisions.
* Coordinate subcontractor performance and Fleet equipment availability, utilization, and demobilization before they affect the critical path.
* Provide weekly project updates and monthly forecasts covering safety, schedule, cost, billing, cash, and client issues.
* Support storm and emergency restoration assignments when requested, including mobilization and billing documentation.

**TEAM LEADERSHIP:**

* Direct superintendents, general foremen, foremen, coordinators, and project support personnel.
* Set measurable expectations and address performance gaps in safety, production, quality, documentation, and schedule.
* Collaborate with estimating, safety, fleet, accounting, procurement, and operations to resolve project constraints.
* Capture lessons learned and help standardize tools and practices that improve project execution.

**PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS:**

* Safety Performance: Meet company safety expectations and promptly close assigned corrective actions.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**


We are a modern marketing collective built for scale, efficiency, and impact. As the parent company, **Agital** supports three specialized agencies: **Go Fish Digital, REQ, and WDG,** with shared infrastructure, advanced technology, and deeply experienced people, allowing each brand to do its best work.

 **Go Fish Digital** is an engineering\-forward performance marketing agency specializing in SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), its Barracuda AI platform, social commerce, and conversion\-focused creative.

  

  

**WDG** designs and builds complex enterprise web experiences for associations, nonprofits, foundations, universities, and other mission\-driven organizations.

  

  

**REQ** is a digital marketing and communications agency specializing in brand, reputation, and advocacy for global organizations across technology, healthcare, finance, hospitality, and real estate.

  

  

Together, we operate as one collaborative ecosystem, combining deep expertise, AI\-powered capabilities, and a culture of curiosity to help ambitious brands grow while creating meaningful opportunities for our people.

 **About the Role**


Go Fish Digital is where digital marketing meets clarity, creativity, and scale. As our agency grows and our client engagements become increasingly complex and cross\-functional, strong project management is essential to ensuring great strategy turns into great execution.

  

The Project Manager serves as the operational backbone of assigned client work. This person creates the structure that allows Client Strategy and delivery teams to execute effectively, turning priorities and decisions into clear tasks, realistic timelines, coordinated resources, and measurable progress.

  

You will work across teams to keep complex client work moving, identify risks before they become problems, and create the visibility teams need to deliver on time and profitably.

 **What You'll Do**


You will own the execution system for a portfolio of complex client accounts and projects.

  

You will partner closely with Client Strategy and delivery teams to translate approved strategy into actionable work, coordinate timelines and dependencies, maintain clear project plans, and ensure teams have the information and capacity needed to deliver.

  

You will not own the client relationship or service strategy. Instead, you will create operational discipline around those functions, making sure decisions turn into action, risks surface early, and commitments remain realistic.

  

Your involvement will vary based on the complexity of the account or project. On some engagements, you may be deeply embedded in internal planning and execution; on others, you may provide lighter project governance and periodic oversight. Go Fish intentionally uses a tiered PM model based on account complexity, revenue impact, coordination burden, timeline risk, capacity needs, and margin exposure.

 **Key Functions**

**Project Planning and Execution**

* Translate approved strategy and project decisions into clear work plans, tasks, milestones, dependencies, owners, and timelines.
* Build and maintain realistic project schedules that reflect scope, priorities, team capacity, and delivery dependencies.
* Monitor execution, adjust plans as conditions change, and ensure decisions consistently move into action.
* Maintain strong project structure in ClickUp so teams understand what needs to happen, who owns it, and when it is due.
* Ensure assigned work meets Go Fish standards for task clarity, ownership, dates, estimates, prioritization, and actionable context.

**Cross\-Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate work across Client Strategy, delivery teams, and other contributors to keep multi\-service and project\-based engagements moving smoothly.
* Translate internal decisions into clear next steps and ensure owners understand dependencies, priorities, and expectations.
* Identify handoff gaps, conflicting priorities, and unclear ownership before they disrupt delivery.
* Maintain continuity as work moves across teams and help ensure important decisions, requests, and project context are not lost.

**Timeline, Capacity, and Risk Management**

* Maintain current, realistic project timelines and proactively identify work at risk of delay.
* Monitor team capacity and workload constraints, escalating trade\-offs before they affect client commitments.
* Surface operational risks related to scope, timelines, dependencies, staffing, or workflow and partner with Client Strategy and delivery leaders on resolution.
* Use sound judgment to address issues directly when possible and escalate repeated or material risks at the appropriate level.
* Regularly review assigned projects to identify overdue work, adjust dependencies, resolve capacity concerns, and protect delivery timelines.

**Margin and Financial Discipline**

* Help protect project and account margin through strong planning, accurate time estimates, workflow control, and visibility into actual effort.
* Monitor time tracking and hours against project expectations, surfacing material variances or scope concerns early.
* Support deferred revenue forecasting and revenue\-recognition schedules for applicable project\-based work.
* Partner with Client Strategy and Operations to identify when project demands exceed planned scope, capacity, or financial assumptions.
* Ensure project\-management practices support both high\-quality delivery and profitable execution. Project\-management KPIs at Go Fish specifically include margin protection, time\-tracking compliance, and deferred\-revenue forecast accuracy where applicable.

**Client Lifecycle and Project Setup**

* Support onboarding and kickoff for assigned accounts by establishing project structure, timelines, milestones, tasks, and internal ownership.
* For project\-based engagements, develop the execution schedule and align the internal team before Client Strategy confirms commitments with the cli

**About Commonpoint:**
Commonpoint is a community\-centered nonprofit dedicated to sustaining and enhancing the quality of life for individuals and families of all ages and abilities across New York City. With deep roots in Queens, Commonpoint now has a footprint in every borough, reflecting its commitment to meeting communities where they are.  

Each year, they serve more than 125,000 community members across more than 95 locations. Their programs reach diverse and neurodiverse populations with comprehensive, inclusive services that move individuals from crisis to stability and toward empowered living. Through education, workforce development, health and mental health care, food access, and community\-based supports, Commonpoint partners with residents to foster economic mobility, social connection, and long\-term resilience. As we continue expanding our reach, including into the Bronx and the Crotona Park area, we remain committed to closing access gaps and creating equitable pathways to opportunity, ensuring every person is valued, supported, and equipped to thrive. **About The Project:**

Working closely with Human Resources, Information Technology, Payroll, hiring managers, and organizational leadership, the consultant will assess current onboarding practices, stabilize day\-to\-day operations, and develop standardized, scalable processes that improve efficiency, accountability, compliance, and the overall employee experience.

* Create standardized onboarding tools, checklists, templates, process maps, and SOPs.
* Define roles and responsibilities across HR, hiring managers, IT, Payroll, and other internal partners.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, AI Ops (GTM)
jobs.description:
**Who we are:**



Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.



Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.



Visit gomotive.com to learn more.


### **About the Role:**



AI Operations at Motive is a cutting edge, low\-ego, collaborative group that is responsible for improving sales productivity through the use of Artificial Intelligence. Our team is small but mighty, responsible for developing, deploying, and maintaining cutting\-edge AI solutions that empower our Sales, Marketing, and Enablement teammates to maximize their productivity.



As our first AI Operations Product Manager, you will be fundamental in establishing our internal AI product strategy and development practices, guiding the creation of AI solutions for 2000\+ sellers.



In this pivotal role, you will wear many hats. As the connective tissue between our Revenue organization’s business needs and our technical teams, you will translate prioritized use cases into clear user stories with actionable development requirements for our Revenue Developers. You will maintain the internal product roadmap, guiding an agile development cycle across user story creation, building a proof\-of\-concept, full scale development, UAT, and ongoing support. You will also serve as a key member of our vendor evaluation team, researching AI vendors that meet the requirements of tools not already within our tech stack, scoring vendors against those requirements, and working across IT, procurement, and legal to progress vendor evaluations.



As a thought leader on AI within our GTM team, you will be responsible for creating \+ owning the processes and policies that GTM team members follow when leveraging AI while setting the standard for how the data that feeds our AI models is collated. In partnership with our Sales Enablement team, you will serve as an AI expert in trainings across the organization, measuring and improving the adoption of the AI tools we launch.



You will be equally comfortable diving into the technical details of how chunking will be implemented in a new application with our Revenue Developers as you are explaining your token consumption forecast to an executive. Above all else, you will be a key part of the team revolutionizing GTM at Motive using AI and play a significant role in the next phase of Motive’s revenue growth.



### **What You'll Do:**


* Serve as the connective glue between the Revenue organization and our Enterprise Systems team of technical engineers for all AI related builds and deployments
* Translate prioritized business use cases into technical development requirements and user stories for GTM AI Ops Revenue Developers and Enterprise Systems to execute on. Work across both parties to keep timelines, project plans, and project scope aligned.
* Establish and maintain processes and policies around AI usage at Motive, in partnership with Motive’s IT leaders.
* Partner with business and data teams to identify, prepare, and maintain high\-quality data sources, ensuring our AI solutions have a strong foundation to leverage.
* Own the internal development roadmap for AI agents, applications, and prompts. Guide an agile development process inclusive of use case intake, sizing (impact and effort), development, QA, release, and ongoing support.
* Collaborate closely with the Revenue Developers who conduct the tactical agent, application, and prompt engineering work, ensuring that built AI tools meet user requirements and business objectives.
* Size the ongoing consumption costs for agentic use cases based on anticipated usage, token consumption, and model selection.
* Create business cases that support Motive’s AI investment priorities and guide prioritization across the AI ops roadmap
* Coordinate AI related vendor evaluations for the GTM team. This includes initial vetting, defining trial success criteria, navigating procurement / infosec / legal, and ensuring all high priority evaluations have an internally built tool included in the evaluation.
* Provide regular updates to executive sponsors and business leaders, explaining technical concepts using common language and focusing on business impact.

### **What We're Looking For:**


* Mixed business and technical background. You can “speak code” with developers and technical teams just as easily as you can understand nuanced business problems with sales teams.
* 5\+ years of product / program management experience, including at least 2 years of experience working directly with engineering resources.
* 2\+ years hands\-on proficiency with GenAI fundamentals — prompt engineering (zero\-/few\-shot, chain\-of\-thought), RAG pipelines, and multi\-agent orchestration.
* Ability to model LLM operating costs (token burn, model choice, usage forecasts) and keep spend within ROI targets.
* Experience creating business cases to justify internal tool investments
* Fluency in Agile for AI: backlog triage, sprints, rapid A/B experiments, and post\-release monitoring.
* Track record steering cross\-functional delivery—acting as “connective tissue” between business, technical, and procurement teams.

*Compliance and Quality Assurance*

* Ensure all network facilities maintain required insurance coverage, business licenses, certifications, and OEM qualifications.

jobs.description:

When you join Assembly Software, you’re joining a team that genuinely cares about you, your career, and your excitement about your job. When you work for a tech company in the legal field, there are endless opportunities ripe for disruption, and you’ll be on the forefront of that innovation. We want you to pursue what drives you and push your boundaries! Assembly Software is where people come to shake up a historically buttoned\-up industry.

Assembly's vision is to provide the legal community the best practice management software that enables client advocacy from anywhere at anytime.

 **Mission Statement**


Our mission is to provide intuitive and comprehensive legal practice management solutions enhancing efficiency and profitability for our customers.

* We are Accountable: We accept responsibility for our choices and actions. We value transparency \+ feedback.
* We Never Stop Learning: We pursue growth \+ learning.

* We are Collaborative Innovators: We are adventurous, creative \+ open\-minded.

* We have Unyielding Integrity: We do the right thin, even when no one is watching.
* We Embrace Diversity \+ Inclusion: We are passionate about creating and cultivating an inclusive culture that promotes and values diversity.
  

There’s a reason our clients stay with Assembly — the platform works, and the people behind it genuinely care. But “staying” isn’t the same as “thriving,” and that’s where you come in.

  

We’re looking for an Account Manager who sees every customer relationship as a growth opportunity — someone who can identify where Deliverable AI fits, where expansion is possible, and where Assembly can go deeper. You’ll own the commercial expansion motion across a portfolio of law firm accounts in your regional territory, working alongside a CSM who keeps clients happy so you can focus on growing the relationship. Your territory is your franchise. Own it.

**What You’ll Do**

* Manage a portfolio of existing law firm accounts, owning renewals, upsells, and expansion revenue
* Build multi\-threaded relationships across your accounts — from paralegals to managing partners
* Run strategic business reviews that go beyond usage dashboards to deliver real insights and uncover growth opportunities
* Partner with Customer Success to keep accounts healthy and intervene early when risk appears

I am tired of the daily grind of a commute, where are you located?

  

With the exception of scheduled visits to our Miami, FL office and scheduled video meetings, you get to work in the comfort of your own home in your PJs if you’d like!

You will be able to elect from competitive health, dental, and vision benefits in addition to short and long term disability, and other supplemental insurance options. You will have 401k, flexible time off, paid parental leave, and an employee assistance program. We value our employees and reward and recognize your contributions.

jobs.title: Care Navigator (Washington- Part-Time)
jobs.description:
**About Nolia Health:**
=======================


Founded in Seattle, Washington, Nolia is a healthcare company dedicated to providing personalized, clinically\-supported, and virtual\-first services for older adults and their family caregivers or care partners. We understand that chronic and serious illnesses related to aging impact not only those diagnosed but also those who care for them. Nolia's mission is to elevate family caregiving as a central component of healthcare. Our goal is to transform the way caregiving is perceived and valued, ensuring that family caregivers have the resources, knowledge, and support they need so no one has to navigate this journey alone.


**Our Vision, Mission and Values are very important to us and can be found** **here.** (https://www.noliahealth.com/about\-us)


**Position Overview:**
======================


We are seeking a Care Navigator to join our expanding transdisciplinary team to support our patients and families affected by chronic conditions and serious illness related to aging. Centering on the needs and goals of the patient and the family caregiver, the Care Navigator helps guide our families through their unique journey by providing ongoing biopsychosocial support, personalized and culturally responsive care\-planning, connection to local community resources, advocacy within social and health systems, coordination with primary care and disease stage specific education.


The Care Navigator will provide high quality care virtually via telehealth to patients/families living in home settings. You will work closely with our clinical team, that includes MD, Neuropsychologists, Nurse Practitioners and Social Workers to provide ongoing case management type support that will evolve with the ever\-changing needs of our patients, and their caregivers.


Join us in redefining healthcare by ensuring our caregivers receive the comprehensive support they deserve. Together, we can create a more compassionate, accessible, equitable and effective care system.


**Primary Responsibilities Include (but are not limited to):**
--------------------------------------------------------------


* Participate as an active member of our transdisciplinary team
* Act as the primary point of contact for caregivers, families, support networks and those living with chronic conditions.
* Actively supports caregivers, families and those living with chronic conditions to enhance quality of life and ensure safety in the home.
* Conduct biopsychosocial assessments to identify strengths, goals, unmet health\-related social needs, safety concerns, and to gain a comprehensive understanding of where our patients and families are in their journey.
* Develop personalized, creative responsive care plans that align with our clients' values, cultural, emotional and spiritual needs.
* Provide disease and stage\-specific education, utilizing our extensive resource library.
* Refer and connect family caregivers, and patients, to community\- based services and supports.
* Communicate with the patient's primary care physician and other healthcare specialists to ensure continuity of care for our clients and patients.
* Provide caregiver education that focuses on identifying caregiver burnout, self\-care, resiliency, skills training and support group services.
* Track and maintain contact frequency based on program model and policy.
* Participate in monthly transdisciplinary meetings to collaborate and coordinate care effectively
* Provide accurate and efficient documentation for all interactions including the presenting issues, goal, intervention and action plan.
* Follow established company policies, procedures and clinical protocols and uphold Nolia's policy on client confidentiality.
* Represent Nolia Health at community events, health fairs, senior centers, and healthcare partner organizations, confidently educating stakeholders about our services and building relationships that generate referrals and community engagement.


**Experience/Skills:**
----------------------


* Preferably 2 years of experience working in a healthcare or community\-based setting.
* Ideally, 1 year of experience (professional or lived) in understanding the needs and challenges faced by family caregivers and older adults
* Demonstrate a deep understanding of cultural humility and the ability to communicate and effectively interact with individuals from diverse cultures, abilities, genders, ethnicities, and races.
* Experience working with Electronic Health Records (EHRs) a plus
* Ability to handle interactions with caregivers and patients involving heightened emotions.
* Strong general computer skills including the ability to navigate various different systems and resources, troubleshoot minor technology issues, and set\-up own work equipment.
* Attention to detail and effective time management and multi\-tasking skills
* Familiarity with healthcare industry, mental health, aging and disability services, or Alzheimer's disease
* Proficiency in another language, other than English, is a plus but not required.

**Benefits of being a part of the Nolia Care Team:**
----------------------------------------------------


* Nolia is an early stage startup committed to healthcare transformation. The opportunities to learn, grow and contribute to our mission are endless
* Various training programs, workshops, and resources are available to help you enhance your skills, knowledge, and expertise in the fields of caregiving and aging.
* We are focused on caregiving and this permeates our working culture. Most of our team have lived experiences as family caregivers. We prioritize your wellbeing and provide a flexible work schedule to accommodate other life responsibilities.
* This is a remote first position that allows for some scheduling flexibility.
* We prioritize inclusivity, teamwork, open communication, and mutual respect, fostering a positive work environment where you can excel and contribute to our shared goals

jobs.description:
STR Operations Manager / Founder’s Right Hand

**Future Director of Operations / GM Opportunity**

**$22–$27/hr \| \~20 Hours/Week to Start \| 90\-Day Paid Trial**

This Is Not a Typical Part\-Time Operations Job

We are looking for an experienced **short\-term rental operator with the ambition and capability to eventually help run multiple growing businesses.**

This position starts part\-time because several of our newest growth initiatives are still ramping.

**The position is not intended to stay small.**

We operate businesses in short\-term rental revenue management, remote STR management, and home services. We have established operations, active leads, new services launching, and significant growth opportunities.

The founder has become too involved in day\-to\-day execution.

We need someone who can eventually become the founder’s **\#2**.

The right person won't simply manage what exists. You'll help us **build and scale what comes next.**

Professional STR Experience Is Required

You should already understand professional STR operations, including:

* Airbnb/Vrbo
* Owner and guest communication
* Property onboarding
* Listing setup/optimization
* Cleaners and maintenance
* PMS platforms such as Guesty, Hospitable, Hostaway, etc.
* PriceLabs or similar dynamic pricing software
* STR performance and revenue\-management fundamentals

Experience professionally operating **20\+ STR properties is strongly preferred**.

We need someone who already understands this industry—not someone we need to teach STR operations from scratch.

What You'll Do

You'll initially work directly with the founder to:

* Coordinate STR client onboarding and operations
* Manage owner communication and routine client issues
* Keep leads, contracts, and onboarding moving
* Coordinate with revenue managers and other team members
* Help manage GoHighLevel CRM and automations
* Improve listings and operational processes
* Build SOPs and scalable systems
* Track KPIs and identify problems
* Follow up with employees and contractors
* Help oversee operations within our home\-services company
* Hold team members accountable
* Solve routine operational problems without involving the founder

Most importantly, you'll help us **scale**.

When we add another 20, 50, or 100 properties, we want you thinking:

**What needs to change? Who do we need? What should we automate? What will break next? How do we grow without creating chaos?**

We don't want to push someone to think this way.

We're looking for someone who naturally does.

Who We're Looking For

You might currently be an STR Operations Manager, Portfolio Manager, Senior Property Manager, or similar professional who knows you're capable of more.

You:

* Take ownership without being chased
* Solve problems before they become emergencies
* Build systems instead of repeatedly fixing the same problem
* Can lead and hold people accountable
* Understand numbers and KPIs
* Communicate professionally with owners
* Make good decisions independently
* Learn technology quickly
* Use automation and AI intelligently
* Think ahead as a company grows
* Want your responsibility and career to grow with the business

We want someone who increasingly tells the founder:

**“I've already handled it.”**

The Upside

Our philosophy is simple:

**The more value you create and the more these businesses grow, the more opportunity there should be for you to grow with them.**

A successful person can progress toward:

**Operations Manager → Director of Operations → General Manager / Founder’s \#2**

That can mean increased hours, compensation, authority, team leadership, and performance\-based compensation opportunities as the role develops.

Advancement isn't automatic. It will be earned through results.

But we are specifically recruiting someone who has the **capability to grow far beyond the starting position.**

Compensation

**$22–$27/hour depending on experience**

Approximately **20 hours/week initially**

**90\-day paid trial**

We will evaluate progress around Days 30, 60, and 90 based on ownership, reliability, problem\-solving, leadership, systems improvement, and how much operational responsibility you've successfully taken from the founder.

Strong performance can lead to increased hours, compensation, responsibility, and a long\-term leadership position.

**We're looking for someone who may eventually become an exceptional operator and business leader.**

Pay: $22\.00 \- $27\.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

* How many STR properties have you professionally helped operate, and what were you personally responsible for?
* Why are you interested in a position that starts part\-time but could develop into running a much larger operation?
* Which PMS, pricing, CRM, and STR platforms have you used?

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
We're hiring a Senior Manager, Implementation Program Manager to own the delivery and relationship for a portfolio of Tendo Insights customers, from contract signature through go\-live and into steady\-state value realization. You'll be the person a hospital's CMO, CFO, and clinical documentation team all trust to bring order to a complex, cross\-functional rollout — one that touches clinical, financial, IT, and executive stakeholders who don't always agree with each other.



This is a senior, largely autonomous role. You'll be expected to build and run your own implementation plans, manage multiple concurrent customer engagements, navigate organizational politics inside customer accounts, and represent Tendo credibly in front of hospital executives while also partnering closely with Sales, Product, and Support to make sure customer commitments are realistic and kept.  

  

**About Tendo**



Make an impact—join our team!  

  

We’re a fast\-growing, mission\-driven company building a culture that enables teams and individuals to thrive. **Our team\-driven culture and rapid growth have** **earned us recognition as one of Forbes’ Top Startup Employers for 2024, 2025, and 2026\.** Led by an experienced and proven team, we live by our values and are always on the hunt for motivated people with diverse experiences and backgrounds to help us improve the care journey for patients, clinicians, and caregivers by creating software that provides seamless, intuitive, and user\-friendly experiences.  

  

If you like working with innovative technologies and want to be part of a growing team that will help transform the healthcare experience, we encourage you to apply today!  

  

**Job Location**



Remote



Tendo has hubs in San Francisco, CA; Salt Lake City, UT; Chicago, IL; Nashville, TN; and Philadelphia, PA. Candidates may be located in any one of our hub locations.



\#LI\-Remote



### **Responsibilities**


* Own end\-to\-end implementation planning for new Tendo Insights customers — building phased project plans, governance structures, and realistic timelines based on each customer's specific data, IT, and organizational constraints.
* Serve as the primary relationship owner for your accounts through implementation, building trusted\-advisor relationships with executive sponsors (CMO/CFO\-level), day\-to\-day champions, and operational stakeholders (CDI, HIM, IT/data teams).
* Identify and proactively manage delivery risk — including organizational and interpersonal risk (e.g., a stakeholder who sees the tool as a threat, competing internal IT priorities) and not just timeline/technical risk.
* Run structured stakeholder communication and escalation cadences, including managing engagements through periods when an executive sponsor has reduced availability.
* Convert high\-level or phased contract commitments into specific, mutually agreed implementation plans with the customer.Build and deliver executive\-level updates and business reviews that connect implementation progress to the value the customer actually cares about — including proposing credible leading indicators when the metrics customers ultimately care about (like annual quality rankings) move too slowly to show in\-quarter progress.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Sales (on scoping and handoff), Product (on customer feedback and gaps), and Support (on transition to steady state) to ensure a seamless customer experience.
* Manage multiple concurrent customer engagements at varying stages of the implementation lifecycle, prioritizing your time across a portfolio rather than a single account.
* Mentor and provide guidance to more junior program/project managers on the team as it scales.
### **Requirements**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 7\+ years of experience in program/project management, implementation, or professional services, ideally in enterprise software, healthcare technology, or a comparably complex B2B environment.
* A track record of managing complex, multi\-stakeholder implementations with executive\-level customer visibility — not just internal project plans.
* Demonstrated judgment in navigating organizational politics and relationship risk within a customer account — you can name the real risk to an engagement, not just the risk that's easy to put in a status report.
* Strong executive communication and presence — comfortable building and delivering a plan or business review directly to a customer's C\-suite, and comfortable being challenged on it in the room.
* Structured, rigorous planning skills: you can build a realistic, dependency\-aware timeline rather than a generic template.
* Experience managing a portfolio of concurrent engagements and prioritizing across competing demands.
### **Nice to Have**

* Experience in healthcare — particularly with hospital or health system operations, clinical quality programs, clinical documentation improvement (CDI), or healthcare data/analytics.
* Familiarity with healthcare quality metrics and ranking programs (e.g., CMS Star Ratings, U.S. News \& World Report rankings, HEDIS, or similar).
* PMP, PgMP, or similar program management certification.
* Experience partnering with clinical, IT, and finance stakeholders simultaneously on the same engagement.

  


**Base Salary Range**



$114,750 \- $155,250



This salary range is offered with the understanding that final compensation is based on a number of factors including geography and experience. Tendo also offers an equity package, annual bonuses, and benefits.

  


**Benefits**



For full time employees, Tendo also offers full health benefits (medical, dental, and vision), flexible spending and health savings accounts, company paid life insurance, company paid short\-term and long\-term disability, company equity, voluntary benefits, 401(k), company paid holidays, flexible time off, and an employee wellness program (“Breathe”).

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, PMO
jobs.description:
**ABOUT BROADVOICE**


At Broadvoice, we believe that exceptional customer experience is the cornerstone of business success. Our AI\-powered contact center and communications solutions are designed to help mid\-market businesses simplify service, enhance satisfaction, and swiftly resolve issues.


Our holistic approach to CX sets us apart in the market. We don't just provide software. We offer a proven CX framework backed by hands\-on support. And our platform was built to be easy to deploy, intuitive to use, and scalable without chaos.


Every role in our company contributes to our mission of providing and creating exceptional experiences. Whether you're in product, sales, support, marketing, or operations, your work directly impacts our customers and, by extension, their customers. Collaboration, innovation, and a shared commitment to excellence define our culture.

 **POSITION SUMMARY**


We are seeking a highly organized and detail\-oriented Manager, Program Management Office (PMO) to establish and lead our program management function. This is a ground\-floor opportunity to build the PMO as a one\-person office initially, with potential to scale as our organization grows. In this role, you will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and cross\-functional leaders to drive alignment, ensure delivery discipline, and bring visibility to key initiatives across our UCaaS and CCaaS portfolio.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Establish the PMO function, defining lightweight processes and governance tailored to an agile SaaS delivery model.
* Partner with product, engineering, and business leaders to plan, track, and report on key initiatives across UCaaS and CCaaS product lines.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, status reporting, and program metrics to ensure visibility for leadership.
* Facilitate cross\-team alignment, identifying and resolving delivery risks and dependencies.
* Support quarterly and monthly planning cadences, ensuring priorities and resourcing are aligned.
* Drive consistency in program execution without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Serve as the single point of contact for program and portfolio reporting, scaling the function over time as needed.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (Master's degree or PMP certification a plus).
* 5\+ years of experience in program or project management, with at least 3 years in a SaaS or cloud\-based technology company.
* Demonstrated ability to be highly organized, detail\-oriented, and effective at managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Familiarity with agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe) and experience adapting governance to agile environments.
* Experience managing programs in UCaaS, CCaaS, or related communications technology preferred.
* Self\-starter comfortable operating as a one\-person PMO, building structure from the ground up.
* Proficiency with program tracking tools (Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar).

 **WHY BROADVOICE**


We're not just building communication tools, we're creating the future of connection. And we need people who want to build it with us.

 **Own Your Growth**  

No cookie\-cutter career paths here. Sharpen your technical edge, step into leadership, or chart a course you haven't even mapped yet. You'll get real mentorship, real resources, and the autonomy to own your outcomes.

 **A Team Built Different**  

Diverse. Inclusive. Real. This is a culture that invests in people, not just performance metrics. You'll be surrounded by people who've got your back and push you to do better work.

 **Impact You Can Point To**  

Your ideas won't get lost in the shuffle. You'll have the backing of a product that competes well, and a direct hand in transforming Broadvoice into a CX powerhouse in the channel.

  

Ready to help us bring our story to life?

  

If you're a strategic thinker who thrives on collaboration and turns ideas into results, we want to meet you. Apply now and lead the charge with us.

### **Company Overview**

  

  

Function Health is the AI operating system for health, designed to empower people to live 100 healthy years. We are redefining how individuals understand, measure, and improve their health by moving beyond the limitations of traditional care and enabling comprehensive, continuous insight into human biology. Function has been recognized as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2024, and is venture\-backed by Redpoint and other leading venture firms. Over half a million members have joined Function to take control of their health.  

  

Through comprehensive lab testing, MRI and CT imaging, longitudinal data, and guidance from AI and clinical teams, Function gives members a complete and continuous view of their health — and the clarity to act on it. Through acquisitions across imaging, mobile phlebotomy, and supplement tracking and optimization, Function is building an integrated health platform that spans the full path from testing to health clarity to daily action.  

  

Function recently announced a $298M Series B and is entering its next chapter of growth. As we scale, the quality and durability of our People systems, data, and insights will directly shape our ability to attract, retain, and support exceptional talent.  

  

We are growing our team and seeking out world\-class talent that deeply believes in our mission to positively impact global health, has a relentless bias toward action, and a growth mindset. Function fosters a collaborative and dynamic environment where every day we build the future.  

  

### **Role**

  

  

The **Revenue Accounting Project Manager** will help build and standardize how Function Health's revenue accounting function operates — the processes it runs on and the systems that support them — without performing the close itself. This role sits at the intersection of accounting, process design, and cross\-functional execution: you'll understand accounting treatment well enough to shape sound requirements and standards, and you'll project\-manage the work needed to get there, in service of a team that owns the close.  

  

You'll work across multiple revenue streams, each with its own systems, maturity level, and open questions. You'll support the team's initiative roadmap by surfacing where a process or control needs attention, then take ownership of sequencing, scoping, and driving that work to a documented, repeatable outcome. That often involves systems and data, but just as often it's about establishing how something should work as a matter of process, independent of any one tool. The ideal candidate has an accounting background and can speak the language fluently, but is energized by building the structure around accounting rather than executing the close itself. You're naturally curious, comfortable digging into ambiguity to find the root cause of a problem, and able to independently manage a project from open questions to a finished, standardized process.  

  

You will report to the **Senior Revenue Accounting Manager,** and operate with a high degree of autonomy on your workstreams while receiving direction on priorities and judgment calls. This is a strong fit for someone who wants ownership over how the function's processes and initiatives take shape — bringing forward what they're noticing, flagging what doesn't make sense, and driving cross\-functional projects to completion with minimal oversight once scoped.  

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

  

* **Support the Senior Manager in shaping the accounting initiative roadmap** — surfacing process gaps, risks, and opportunities, then owning the scoping and prioritization of your workstreams once direction is set.
* **Design and standardize accounting processes and controls across revenue streams** — independent of any single system — so operations run consistently and predictably as the business scales.
* **Own end\-to\-end project management for revenue accounting initiatives** — scoping requirements, sequencing workstreams, tracking open items across stakeholders, and driving projects to completion against a deadline.
* **Serve as the connective tissue between Accounting and Data/Engineering, Finance, and Product** — gathering requirements, resolving ambiguity between teams, and ensuring decisions made in one function are accurately reflected in another.

* **Investigate data quality and process breakdowns by working directly with underlying datasets** — tracing issues to root cause rather than reconciling around them, and partnering with Data/Engineering to fix them at the source.
* Build and maintain documentation, mapping logic, and handoff materials that convert undocumented or ad hoc knowledge into clear, auditable procedures the accounting team can run against.
* Prepare clear, organized documentation and data support for external audit and advisory partners on request, without owning the audit relationship directly.
  

  

### **Qualifications/Skills**

  

  

* 7\+ years of progressive experience spanning accounting and either project management, business/systems analysis, or accounting operations; ***Big 4 public accounting experience is strongly preferred.***
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

* Experience designing or standardizing operational processes and controls, not just exe

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
#### **About Melita**



For more than 30 years, Melita Group has helped small and mid\-sized employers solve the complexity of HR, Employee Benefits, and Payroll. We combine deep expertise with a modern technology platform to deliver outsourced services that let our clients focus on growing their businesses while we handle the operational backbone of their workforce. We are a results\-driven, high\-integrity organization that holds itself accountable to its promises, and our clients stay with us for years, often decades, because we treat their success as our own. As we scale, we are investing heavily in technology, automation, and AI to raise the bar on what an HR outsourcing partner can deliver.


#### **The Opportunity**



Every new client relationship begins with implementation, and the quality of that experience sets the trajectory for retention, expansion, and reference\-ability for years to come. The Implementation Specialist is a hands\-on role that supports bringing complex HR, benefits, and payroll clients live on our platform. You will do the configuration, data migration, and testing yourself, not just manage it from a distance.



Reporting to the Head of Implementations, you will support onboardings end to end and be the connective tissue that ensures what was sold is what gets delivered. This role is ideal for someone who has implemented outsourced Payroll and HR services at a PEO, an HRO, or an HRIS technology vendor, and who wants to do the work, contribute to the outcome, and help shape how we implement as we scale.


#### **Reporting and Scope**


* **Reports to:** Head of Implementations (Molly Taylor)
* **Department and team:** Client Success, Implementation Team
* **Location:** Remote (U.S.)
* **Key partners:** Sales, Client Success, Service Delivery, the internal Technology team, Product, and Finance, along with HRIS and benefits carrier partners

### **Core Responsibilities:**


#### **Client Implementations (hands\-on)**


* Support and help execute new client onboardings across HR administration, payroll, benefits, and leave of absence services, from kickoff to a clean handoff to the ongoing service teams.
* Contribute directly to the outcomes that matter: time to live, client satisfaction at go\-live, and a smooth transition to Service Delivery.
* Help build and maintain the implementation project plan, support progress against milestones, and help keep every workstream on schedule.

#### **Platform Configuration, Data Migration, and Integrations (hands\-on)**


* Configure the client's HRIS and complete the build yourself on platforms including ADP Workforce Now, Paylocity, and Rippling, and in our Salesforce environment.
* Run data migrations and validate the results: employee data, payroll history, benefit plans and deductions, and PTO balances.
* Stand up the data interfaces that keep everything in sync, including benefits carrier EDI feeds and GL file feeds, partnering with our internal Technology team where deeper build is required.

#### **Cross\-Functional Partnership**


* Work hand\-in\-hand with Sales, Client Success, Service Delivery, Product, and Finance to align on client expectations, scope, pricing assumptions, and post\-implementation transitions.
* Be the connective tissue that ensures what was sold is what gets delivered.

#### **AI, Automation, and Continuous Improvement**


* Identify and champion opportunities to apply AI, automation, and modern tooling to implementation workflows. This is a priority investment area for Melita.
* Document and improve implementation workflows so each onboarding is faster and cleaner than the last.

#### **What We Are Looking For**


* Very strong, hands\-on experience supporting and implementing outsourced Payroll and HR services, ideally gained at a PEO, an HRO, or an HRIS technology vendor that installs a full HRIS together with outsourced services.
* Hands\-on HRIS implementation experience on one or more major platforms (ADP Workforce Now, Paylocity, or Rippling), including configuration and data migration.
